CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.large_import173_certificate_seal()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public'
 SET "TimeZone" TO 'UTC'
AS $function$
BEGIN
 IF TG_OP<>'INSERT' OR current_user<>session_user OR NOT NEW.singleton
 OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.large_import173_certificate)
 OR NEW.profile IS DISTINCT FROM public.large_import173_metadata()
 OR NEW.predecessor_map IS DISTINCT FROM public.large_import173_predecessor_map()
 OR public.large_import173_parents_valid() IS DISTINCT FROM true THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'Large import173 certificate is immutable' USING ERRCODE='23514';
 END IF;RETURN NEW;
END
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.large_import173_immutable(j jsonb)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE sql
 IMMUTABLE
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$
 SELECT jsonb_build_object('schema',j->'schema','id',j->'id','principal',j->'principal','raw',j->'raw','manifest',j->'manifest','parsing_spec',j->'parsing_spec','plan_hash',j->'plan_hash',
 'core',(SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('previewKey',c->'previewKey','executeKey',c->'executeKey','request',c->'request','identities',c->'identities') ORDER BY n) FROM jsonb_array_elements(j->'core') WITH ORDINALITY AS a(c,n)))

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.large_import173_metadata()
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public'
 SET "TimeZone" TO 'UTC'
AS $function$
-- Fixed owner SELECT, also used verbatim by startup; it invokes no candidate helper.
-- Portable semantic identifiers; generated FK trigger allocation names/OIDs are deliberately excluded.
WITH RECURSIVE own AS (SELECT c.* FROM pg_class c WHERE c.relnamespace='public'::regnamespace
 AND (starts_with(c.relname,'large_import_') OR starts_with(c.relname,'large_import173_'))),
 own_functions AS (SELECT p.* FROM pg_proc p WHERE p.pronamespace='public'::regnamespace
 AND (starts_with(p.proname,'large_import_') OR starts_with(p.proname,'large_import173_'))),
 reachable(role_oid) AS (SELECT oid FROM pg_roles WHERE rolname='dyna_app' UNION SELECT relowner FROM own UNION SELECT nspowner FROM pg_namespace WHERE oid='public'::regnamespace UNION SELECT m.roleid FROM pg_auth_members m JOIN reachable r ON r.role_oid=m.member)
SELECT jsonb_build_object(
 'namespace',(SELECT jsonb_build_object('name',nspname,'owner',pg_get_userbyid(nspowner),'acl_is_null',nspacl IS NULL,'acl',public.pim_dictionary_acl_metadata(coalesce(nspacl,acldefault('n'::"char",nspowner)))) FROM pg_namespace WHERE oid='public'::regnamespace),
 'default_acl',(SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('owner',pg_get_userbyid(defaclrole),'schema',CASE WHEN defaclnamespace=0 THEN NULL ELSE defaclnamespace::regnamespace::text END,'kind',defaclobjtype,'acl',public.pim_dictionary_acl_metadata(defaclacl)) ORDER BY pg_get_userbyid(defaclrole)::text,defaclnamespace::regnamespace::text,defaclobjtype),'[]'::jsonb) FROM pg_default_acl WHERE defaclrole IN(SELECT role_oid FROM reachable) AND defaclnamespace IN(0,'public'::regnamespace::oid)),
 'reserved',(SELECT jsonb_build_object('constraints',(SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('name',conname,'relation',conrelid::regclass::text) ORDER BY conrelid::regclass::text,conname),'[]'::jsonb) FROM pg_constraint WHERE connamespace='public'::regnamespace AND (starts_with(conname,'large_import_') OR starts_with(conname,'large_import173_'))),'triggers',(SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('name',tgname,'relation',tgrelid::regclass::text) ORDER BY tgrelid::regclass::text,tgname),'[]'::jsonb) FROM pg_trigger WHERE NOT tgisinternal AND (starts_with(tgname,'large_import_') OR starts_with(tgname,'large_import173_'))),'policies',(SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('name',polname,'relation',polrelid::regclass::text) ORDER BY polrelid::regclass::text,polname),'[]'::jsonb) FROM pg_policy WHERE starts_with(polname,'large_import_') OR starts_with(polname,'large_import173_')))),
 'classes',(SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('name',relname,'kind',relkind,'owner',pg_get_userbyid(relowner),'persistence',relpersistence,'acl',public.pim_dictionary_acl_metadata(coalesce(relacl,acldefault('r'::"char",relowner)))) ORDER BY relname),'[]'::jsonb) FROM own),
 'relations',(SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('name',c.relname,'kind',c.relkind,'owner',pg_get_userbyid(c.relowner),'persistence',c.relpersistence,'rls',c.relrowsecurity,'force_rls',c.relforcerowsecurity,'replica_identity',c.relreplident,'options',c.reloptions,'access_method',am.amname,
 'acl',public.pim_dictionary_acl_metadata(coalesce(c.relacl,acldefault('r'::"char",c.relowner))),
 'columns',(SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('position',a.attnum,'dropped',a.attisdropped,'dimensions',a.attndims,'length',a.attlen,'by_value',a.attbyval,'alignment',a.attalign,'has_missing',a.atthasmissing,'missing_value',to_jsonb(a.attmissingval),'name',a.attname,'type',format_type(a.atttypid,a.atttypmod),'not_null',a.attnotnull,'identity',a.attidentity,'generated',a.attgenerated,'storage',a.attstorage,'compression',a.attcompression,'statistics',a.attstattarget,'options',a.attoptions,'collation',CASE WHEN a.attcollation=0 THEN NULL ELSE a.attcollation::regcollation::text END,'default',pg_get_expr(d.adbin,d.adrelid),'acl',public.pim_dictionary_acl_metadata(a.attacl)) ORDER BY a.attnum),'[]'::jsonb) FROM pg_attribute a LEFT JOIN pg_attrdef d ON(d.adrelid,d.adnum)=(a.attrelid,a.attnum) WHERE a.attrelid=c.oid AND a.attnum>0),
 'constraints',(SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('name',conname,'kind',contype,'validated',convalidated,'enforced',conenforced,'period',conperiod,'local',conislocal,'inheritance_count',coninhcount,'no_inherit',connoinherit,'parent',CASE WHEN conparentid=0 THEN NULL ELSE (SELECT jsonb_build_object('name',par.conname,'relation',par.conrelid::regclass::text) FROM pg_constraint par WHERE par.oid=con.conparentid) END,'deferrable',condeferrable,'deferred',condeferred,'definition',pg_get_constraintdef(oid,true),'columns',(SELECT jsonb_agg(a.attname ORDER BY n) FROM unnest(conkey) WITH ORDINALITY k(attnum,n) JOIN pg_attribute a ON(a.attrelid,a.attnum)=(conrelid,k.attnum)),'foreign_relation',CASE WHEN confrelid=0 THEN NULL ELSE confrelid::regclass::text END,'foreign_columns',(SELECT jsonb_agg(a.attname ORDER BY n) FROM unnest(confkey) WITH ORDINALITY k(attnum,n) JOIN pg_attribute a ON(a.attrelid,a.attnum)=(confrelid,k.attnum)),'update',confupdtype,'delete',confdeltype,'match',confmatchtype) ORDER BY conname),'[]'::jsonb) FROM pg_constraint con WHERE con.conrelid=c.oid),
 'indexes',(SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('name',idx.relname,'definition',pg_get_indexdef(i.indexrelid),'valid',i.indisvalid,'ready',i.indisready,'live',i.indislive,'unique',i.indisunique,'primary',i.indisprimary,'clustered',i.indisclustered,'replica_identity',i.indisreplident,'options',idx.reloptions,'owner',pg_get_userbyid(idx.relowner),'access_method',iam.amname) ORDER BY idx.relname),'[]'::jsonb) FROM pg_index i JOIN pg_class idx ON idx.oid=i.indexrelid LEFT JOIN pg_am iam ON iam.oid=idx.relam WHERE i.indrelid=c.oid),
 'policies',(SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('name',polname,'command',polcmd,'permissive',polpermissive,'roles',(SELECT jsonb_agg(CASE WHEN id=0 THEN 'PUBLIC' ELSE pg_get_userbyid(id) END ORDER BY CASE WHEN id=0 THEN 'PUBLIC' ELSE pg_get_userbyid(id)::text END) FROM unnest(polroles) r(id)),'using',pg_get_expr(polqual,polrelid),'check',pg_get_expr(polwithcheck,polrelid)) ORDER BY polname),'[]'::jsonb) FROM pg_policy WHERE polrelid=c.oid),
 'triggers',(SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('name',tgname,'type',tgtype,'enabled',tgenabled,'definition',pg_get_triggerdef(oid,true),'function',tgfoid::regprocedure::text,'arguments_hex',encode(tgargs,'hex'),'deferrable',tgdeferrable,'deferred',tginitdeferred,'parent',CASE WHEN tgparentid=0 THEN NULL ELSE (SELECT tgname FROM pg_trigger p WHERE p.oid=t.tgparentid) END) ORDER BY tgname),'[]'::jsonb) FROM pg_trigger t WHERE tgrelid=c.oid AND NOT tgisinternal)) ORDER BY c.relname),'[]'::jsonb) FROM own c LEFT JOIN pg_am am ON am.oid=c.relam WHERE c.relkind IN('r','p','v','m','S','f')),
 'functions',(SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(public.pim_dictionary_function_metadata(oid)||jsonb_build_object('body_sha256',encode(sha256(convert_to(prosrc,'UTF8')),'hex')) ORDER BY oid::regprocedure::text),'[]'::jsonb) FROM own_functions),
 'types',(SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('name',t.typname,'kind',t.typtype,'category',t.typcategory,'owner',pg_get_userbyid(t.typowner),'relation',CASE WHEN t.typrelid=0 THEN NULL ELSE t.typrelid::regclass::text END,'element',CASE WHEN t.typelem=0 THEN NULL ELSE format_type(t.typelem,NULL) END,'not_null',t.typnotnull,'default',t.typdefault,'acl',public.pim_dictionary_acl_metadata(coalesce(t.typacl,acldefault('T'::"char",t.typowner)))) ORDER BY t.typname),'[]'::jsonb) FROM pg_type t WHERE t.typnamespace='public'::regnamespace AND (starts_with(t.typname,'large_import_') OR starts_with(t.typname,'large_import173_') OR starts_with(t.typname,'_large_import_') OR starts_with(t.typname,'_large_import173_'))),
 'ri',(SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('relation',tr.tgrelid::regclass::text,'constraint_relation',con.conrelid::regclass::text,'constraint',con.conname,'definition',pg_get_constraintdef(con.oid,true),'type',tr.tgtype,'enabled',tr.tgenabled,'function',tr.tgfoid::regprocedure::text,'deferrable',tr.tgdeferrable,'deferred',tr.tginitdeferred) ORDER BY tr.tgrelid::regclass::text,con.conrelid::regclass::text,con.conname,tr.tgtype,tr.tgfoid::regprocedure::text),'[]'::jsonb) FROM pg_trigger tr JOIN pg_constraint con ON con.oid=tr.tgconstraint WHERE tr.tgisinternal AND (con.conrelid IN(SELECT oid FROM own) OR con.confrelid IN(SELECT oid FROM own))),
 'roles',(SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(r)-'oid'-'rolpassword' ORDER BY rolname),'[]'::jsonb) FROM pg_roles r WHERE oid IN(SELECT role_oid FROM reachable)),
 'memberships',(SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('role',pg_get_userbyid(roleid),'member',pg_get_userbyid(member),'grantor',pg_get_userbyid(grantor),'admin',admin_option,'inherit',inherit_option,'set',set_option) ORDER BY roleid::regrole::text,member::regrole::text,grantor::regrole::text),'[]'::jsonb) FROM pg_auth_members WHERE member IN(SELECT role_oid FROM reachable) OR roleid IN(SELECT role_oid FROM reachable))
) profile
$function$

 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public'
 SET "TimeZone" TO 'UTC'
AS $function$
DECLARE expected record;live_sha text;
BEGIN
 -- Delegation is permitted only for these exact native172 bodies. The certificate
 -- relation forces the successor172 branch; no legacy fallback or cached result.
 IF to_regclass('public.nested172_certificate') IS NULL THEN RETURN false;END IF;
 FOR expected IN SELECT * FROM (VALUES
  ('public.pim_dictionary_valid()', '15e70233f2034a1b19b049711f24d94d64ea0080c90625bb44ebb1ce49560c7e'),
  ('public.cooperation171_valid()', '550e10f6a3be197027f6c988acf6d5d9bd0b5fb7ca0fb1d3f862fdd0fcd08a02'),

  ('public.buyer_address_guards()', '390878abaad2515009a8ae2093f8f4f3d1a1c5ede13ad09ec7b846b965de70d1'),
  ('public.catalog_stock_control_guards()', 'ef9c31fbabca36776256efe76dcd16265c9f742ce4a64cbd7cc000c056baf225'),

  ('public.catalog_stock_return_guards()', '10e530165ee50fdc8dc19501d97ac41819ed00ecf22b99995e0bcd24ce8453ec'),
  ('public.competitor_observation_guards()', 'b6088d080b4287caa3aaaa5715a48c47d8ab271b4deeb10bdb818b04bf2e6438'),
  ('public.credit_source_upgrade_valid()', 'f190ad4c0910b8c4fc1b096f8083c8fb31e0608cdb5e1322746c432b1cc9b476'),
  ('public.fa3_draft_guards()', '96df6ad175f209dc8fb3745e3309ef7b90ad6beae50e2739a5d832078a261ec4'),
  ('public.financial_return_guards()', 'a93da2ff6e455726f85d6cc2b5b8b61cde4100e1d835dcfd5b0f707b2307f671'),

  ('public.label_print_guards()', '8e5a593f60e473cc06c25b33f9d2564fa6baf01d4c6e95a1d9699527aba614c8'),
  ('public.local_invoice_guards()', '2e8f6b0663db8c5e202ba89f24e5edf401944cda24d0101377fa463c953556a6'),
  ('public.manual_inventory_off_valid()', '01b58d1d515fac4efa1bc9813cad2c2325518ae0344c87344a26034b10ab48cc'),

  ('public.parcel_physical_wz_valid()', 'dffc9ec017d37346c8ae07a828c774ab59a056de102f6877c479e8a07d569443'),
  ('public.print_job_guards()', '22a80b97d2dd6cbcee224440167e06bedf45a918aebdcb054781d2ef97002b88'),
  ('public.product_rule_price_tags_guards()', '50e108f5c95e0b774984c034393c6e97d8266285094ee5e64b68d2c0173c11ff'),
  ('public.product_rule_schedule_guards()', 'd7e4b406c55d954900999f0c8382313a0d4c915aa8345c249dc1e7d9910df0f1'),
  ('public.stocktake_adjustment_guards()', '09ed6c60812033a3b703a1f7881322da2c7231a142d090b2e06f32793f42cfaa'),
  ('public.warehouse_automatic_wz_guards()', 'f471bb00471a10f0c4469e440a539da6bf625664c0de6eef19669dce556b4ef7'),

  SELECT encode(sha256(convert_to(prosrc,'UTF8')),'hex') INTO live_sha
   FROM pg_proc WHERE oid=to_regprocedure(expected.signature);
  IF live_sha IS DISTINCT FROM expected.body_sha256 THEN RETURN false;END IF;
 END LOOP;

 -- nested172_valid(), then15 super-guards covering all25 current predecessors.
 -- Whole173 profile/predecessor equality remains in large_import173_valid().
 -- Query cancellation has no handler here and propagates as57014.
 RETURN public.large_import173_pim_valid() IS NOT DISTINCT FROM true;
END

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.large_import173_require(expected_profile_sha256 text)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public'
 SET "TimeZone" TO 'UTC'
AS $function$
BEGIN
 IF expected_profile_sha256 IS NULL OR expected_profile_sha256 !~ '^[a-f0-9]{64}$'
 OR (SELECT profile_sha256 FROM public.large_import173_certificate WHERE singleton) IS DISTINCT FROM expected_profile_sha256
 OR encode(sha256(convert_to(public.large_import173_metadata()::text,'UTF8')),'hex') IS DISTINCT FROM expected_profile_sha256
 OR public.large_import173_valid() IS DISTINCT FROM true THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'Large import173 certificate failed' USING ERRCODE='23514';
 END IF;
END
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.large_import173_validate_recovered(expected_profile_sha256 text)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public'
 SET "TimeZone" TO 'UTC'
AS $function$
BEGIN
 -- Detached restoration compares portable descriptors, roles and bodies; never claims restored OID equality.
 PERFORM public.large_import173_require(expected_profile_sha256);RETURN true;
EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN RETURN false;
END
$function$

 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 IMMUTABLE
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$
 SELECT CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(v)='object' THEN
   (SELECT count(*) FROM jsonb_object_keys(v))=cardinality(names) AND v ?& names

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.large_import_core_scope173_index(s text)
 RETURNS bigint
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 IMMUTABLE STRICT
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$
BEGIN
 -- JS array-index property: canonical decimal0..2^32-2.2^32-1 and zero-padded names are ordinary strings.
 IF length(s)=0 OR length(s)>10 OR s~'[^0-9]' OR length(s)>1 AND left(s,1)='0' THEN RETURN NULL;END IF;
 IF s::numeric<=4294967294 THEN RETURN s::bigint;END IF;
 RETURN NULL;
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.large_import_core_scope173_quote(s text)
 RETURNS text
 LANGUAGE sql
 IMMUTABLE STRICT
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$
 SELECT chr(34)||coalesce(string_agg(CASE
  WHEN cp=34 OR cp=92 THEN chr(92)||ch
  WHEN cp=8 THEN chr(92)||'b' WHEN cp=9 THEN chr(92)||'t' WHEN cp=10 THEN chr(92)||'n'
  WHEN cp=12 THEN chr(92)||'f' WHEN cp=13 THEN chr(92)||'r'
  WHEN cp<32 THEN chr(92)||'u'||lpad(to_hex(cp),4,'0')
  ELSE ch END,'' ORDER BY i),'')||chr(34)
 FROM (SELECT i,substr(s,i,1) ch,ascii(substr(s,i,1)) cp FROM generate_series(1,char_length(s)) i) x
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.large_import_quota_lock_cleanup_pin173(u uuid, t uuid, k uuid, q uuid, token text, key0 text, n bigint, sha text)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public'
 SET "TimeZone" TO 'UTC'
AS $function$
DECLARE b record;x record;
BEGIN
 IF current_setting('role',true) IS DISTINCT FROM 'dyna_app' OR current_setting('app.tenant_id',true) IS DISTINCT FROM t::text
 OR session_user IS DISTINCT FROM pg_get_userbyid((SELECT relowner FROM pg_class WHERE oid='public.large_import173_certificate'::regclass))
 OR public.large_import173_valid() IS DISTINCT FROM true THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Cleanup requires certified owned app transport' USING ERRCODE='42501';END IF;
 -- No global/tenant quota locks: caller already committed intents; no new capacity or receipt allocation occurs here.
 SELECT * INTO b FROM public.large_import_quota_reservations173 WHERE tenant_id=t AND id=q AND actor_id=u AND api_key_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM k AND token_hash=token FOR SHARE;
 IF NOT FOUND OR b.kind IS DISTINCT FROM 'upload' OR b.state='retained' THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Cleanup reservation not active/owned' USING ERRCODE='42501';END IF;
 SELECT * INTO x FROM public.large_import_quota_resources173 WHERE tenant_id=t AND reservation_id=q AND resource_key=key0 FOR SHARE;
 IF NOT FOUND OR x.kind IS DISTINCT FROM 'blob' OR x.state='released' OR x.byte_count IS DISTINCT FROM n OR x.sha256 IS DISTINCT FROM sha
 OR key0 !~ '^blob:fs:(blobs|uploads|witnesses):[a-f0-9-]{36}:lock:[a-f0-9-]{36}$'
 OR (x.payload_text::jsonb->>'schema') IS DISTINCT FROM 'private-import-lock/v1'
 OR (x.payload_text::jsonb->>'id') IS DISTINCT FROM split_part(key0,':',6)
 OR (SELECT count(*) FROM jsonb_object_keys(x.payload_text::jsonb))<>2 THEN
 RAISE EXCEPTION 'Cleanup only permits original exact transient lock' USING ERRCODE='42501';END IF;
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.large_import173_certificate_seal()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public'
 SET "TimeZone" TO 'UTC'
AS $function$
BEGIN
 IF TG_OP<>'INSERT' OR current_user<>session_user OR NOT NEW.singleton
 OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.large_import173_certificate)
 OR NEW.profile IS DISTINCT FROM public.large_import173_metadata()
 OR NEW.predecessor_map IS DISTINCT FROM public.large_import173_predecessor_map()
 OR public.large_import173_parents_valid() IS DISTINCT FROM true THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'Large import173 certificate is immutable' USING ERRCODE='23514';
 END IF;RETURN NEW;
END
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.large_import173_immutable(j jsonb)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE sql
 IMMUTABLE
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$
 SELECT jsonb_build_object('schema',j->'schema','id',j->'id','principal',j->'principal','raw',j->'raw','manifest',j->'manifest','parsing_spec',j->'parsing_spec','plan_hash',j->'plan_hash',
 'core',(SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('previewKey',c->'previewKey','executeKey',c->'executeKey','request',c->'request','identities',c->'identities') ORDER BY n) FROM jsonb_array_elements(j->'core') WITH ORDINALITY AS a(c,n)))
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.large_import173_metadata()
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public'
 SET "TimeZone" TO 'UTC'
AS $function$
-- Fixed owner SELECT, also used verbatim by startup; it invokes no candidate helper.
-- Portable semantic identifiers; generated FK trigger allocation names/OIDs are deliberately excluded.
WITH RECURSIVE own AS (SELECT c.* FROM pg_class c WHERE c.relnamespace='public'::regnamespace
 AND (starts_with(c.relname,'large_import_') OR starts_with(c.relname,'large_import173_'))),
 own_functions AS (SELECT p.* FROM pg_proc p WHERE p.pronamespace='public'::regnamespace
 AND (starts_with(p.proname,'large_import_') OR starts_with(p.proname,'large_import173_'))),
 reachable(role_oid) AS (SELECT oid FROM pg_roles WHERE rolname='dyna_app' UNION SELECT relowner FROM own UNION SELECT nspowner FROM pg_namespace WHERE oid='public'::regnamespace UNION SELECT m.roleid FROM pg_auth_members m JOIN reachable r ON r.role_oid=m.member)
SELECT jsonb_build_object(
 'namespace',(SELECT jsonb_build_object('name',nspname,'owner',pg_get_userbyid(nspowner),'acl_is_null',nspacl IS NULL,'acl',public.pim_dictionary_acl_metadata(coalesce(nspacl,acldefault('n'::"char",nspowner)))) FROM pg_namespace WHERE oid='public'::regnamespace),
 'default_acl',(SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('owner',pg_get_userbyid(defaclrole),'schema',CASE WHEN defaclnamespace=0 THEN NULL ELSE defaclnamespace::regnamespace::text END,'kind',defaclobjtype,'acl',public.pim_dictionary_acl_metadata(defaclacl)) ORDER BY pg_get_userbyid(defaclrole)::text,defaclnamespace::regnamespace::text,defaclobjtype),'[]'::jsonb) FROM pg_default_acl WHERE defaclrole IN(SELECT role_oid FROM reachable) AND defaclnamespace IN(0,'public'::regnamespace::oid)),
 'reserved',(SELECT jsonb_build_object('constraints',(SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('name',conname,'relation',conrelid::regclass::text) ORDER BY conrelid::regclass::text,conname),'[]'::jsonb) FROM pg_constraint WHERE connamespace='public'::regnamespace AND (starts_with(conname,'large_import_') OR starts_with(conname,'large_import173_'))),'triggers',(SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('name',tgname,'relation',tgrelid::regclass::text) ORDER BY tgrelid::regclass::text,tgname),'[]'::jsonb) FROM pg_trigger WHERE NOT tgisinternal AND (starts_with(tgname,'large_import_') OR starts_with(tgname,'large_import173_'))),'policies',(SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('name',polname,'relation',polrelid::regclass::text) ORDER BY polrelid::regclass::text,polname),'[]'::jsonb) FROM pg_policy WHERE starts_with(polname,'large_import_') OR starts_with(polname,'large_import173_')))),
 'classes',(SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('name',relname,'kind',relkind,'owner',pg_get_userbyid(relowner),'persistence',relpersistence,'acl',public.pim_dictionary_acl_metadata(coalesce(relacl,acldefault('r'::"char",relowner)))) ORDER BY relname),'[]'::jsonb) FROM own),
 'relations',(SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('name',c.relname,'kind',c.relkind,'owner',pg_get_userbyid(c.relowner),'persistence',c.relpersistence,'rls',c.relrowsecurity,'force_rls',c.relforcerowsecurity,'replica_identity',c.relreplident,'options',c.reloptions,'access_method',am.amname,
 'acl',public.pim_dictionary_acl_metadata(coalesce(c.relacl,acldefault('r'::"char",c.relowner))),
 'columns',(SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('position',a.attnum,'dropped',a.attisdropped,'dimensions',a.attndims,'length',a.attlen,'by_value',a.attbyval,'alignment',a.attalign,'has_missing',a.atthasmissing,'missing_value',to_jsonb(a.attmissingval),'name',a.attname,'type',format_type(a.atttypid,a.atttypmod),'not_null',a.attnotnull,'identity',a.attidentity,'generated',a.attgenerated,'storage',a.attstorage,'compression',a.attcompression,'statistics',a.attstattarget,'options',a.attoptions,'collation',CASE WHEN a.attcollation=0 THEN NULL ELSE a.attcollation::regcollation::text END,'default',pg_get_expr(d.adbin,d.adrelid),'acl',public.pim_dictionary_acl_metadata(a.attacl)) ORDER BY a.attnum),'[]'::jsonb) FROM pg_attribute a LEFT JOIN pg_attrdef d ON(d.adrelid,d.adnum)=(a.attrelid,a.attnum) WHERE a.attrelid=c.oid AND a.attnum>0),
 'constraints',(SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('name',conname,'kind',contype,'validated',convalidated,'enforced',conenforced,'period',conperiod,'local',conislocal,'inheritance_count',coninhcount,'no_inherit',connoinherit,'parent',CASE WHEN conparentid=0 THEN NULL ELSE (SELECT jsonb_build_object('name',par.conname,'relation',par.conrelid::regclass::text) FROM pg_constraint par WHERE par.oid=con.conparentid) END,'deferrable',condeferrable,'deferred',condeferred,'definition',pg_get_constraintdef(oid,true),'columns',(SELECT jsonb_agg(a.attname ORDER BY n) FROM unnest(conkey) WITH ORDINALITY k(attnum,n) JOIN pg_attribute a ON(a.attrelid,a.attnum)=(conrelid,k.attnum)),'foreign_relation',CASE WHEN confrelid=0 THEN NULL ELSE confrelid::regclass::text END,'foreign_columns',(SELECT jsonb_agg(a.attname ORDER BY n) FROM unnest(confkey) WITH ORDINALITY k(attnum,n) JOIN pg_attribute a ON(a.attrelid,a.attnum)=(confrelid,k.attnum)),'update',confupdtype,'delete',confdeltype,'match',confmatchtype) ORDER BY conname),'[]'::jsonb) FROM pg_constraint con WHERE con.conrelid=c.oid),
 'indexes',(SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('name',idx.relname,'definition',pg_get_indexdef(i.indexrelid),'valid',i.indisvalid,'ready',i.indisready,'live',i.indislive,'unique',i.indisunique,'primary',i.indisprimary,'clustered',i.indisclustered,'replica_identity',i.indisreplident,'options',idx.reloptions,'owner',pg_get_userbyid(idx.relowner),'access_method',iam.amname) ORDER BY idx.relname),'[]'::jsonb) FROM pg_index i JOIN pg_class idx ON idx.oid=i.indexrelid LEFT JOIN pg_am iam ON iam.oid=idx.relam WHERE i.indrelid=c.oid),
 'policies',(SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('name',polname,'command',polcmd,'permissive',polpermissive,'roles',(SELECT jsonb_agg(CASE WHEN id=0 THEN 'PUBLIC' ELSE pg_get_userbyid(id) END ORDER BY CASE WHEN id=0 THEN 'PUBLIC' ELSE pg_get_userbyid(id)::text END) FROM unnest(polroles) r(id)),'using',pg_get_expr(polqual,polrelid),'check',pg_get_expr(polwithcheck,polrelid)) ORDER BY polname),'[]'::jsonb) FROM pg_policy WHERE polrelid=c.oid),
 'triggers',(SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('name',tgname,'type',tgtype,'enabled',tgenabled,'definition',pg_get_triggerdef(oid,true),'function',tgfoid::regprocedure::text,'arguments_hex',encode(tgargs,'hex'),'deferrable',tgdeferrable,'deferred',tginitdeferred,'parent',CASE WHEN tgparentid=0 THEN NULL ELSE (SELECT tgname FROM pg_trigger p WHERE p.oid=t.tgparentid) END) ORDER BY tgname),'[]'::jsonb) FROM pg_trigger t WHERE tgrelid=c.oid AND NOT tgisinternal)) ORDER BY c.relname),'[]'::jsonb) FROM own c LEFT JOIN pg_am am ON am.oid=c.relam WHERE c.relkind IN('r','p','v','m','S','f')),
 'functions',(SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(public.pim_dictionary_function_metadata(oid)||jsonb_build_object('body_sha256',encode(sha256(convert_to(prosrc,'UTF8')),'hex')) ORDER BY oid::regprocedure::text),'[]'::jsonb) FROM own_functions),
 'types',(SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('name',t.typname,'kind',t.typtype,'category',t.typcategory,'owner',pg_get_userbyid(t.typowner),'relation',CASE WHEN t.typrelid=0 THEN NULL ELSE t.typrelid::regclass::text END,'element',CASE WHEN t.typelem=0 THEN NULL ELSE format_type(t.typelem,NULL) END,'not_null',t.typnotnull,'default',t.typdefault,'acl',public.pim_dictionary_acl_metadata(coalesce(t.typacl,acldefault('T'::"char",t.typowner)))) ORDER BY t.typname),'[]'::jsonb) FROM pg_type t WHERE t.typnamespace='public'::regnamespace AND (starts_with(t.typname,'large_import_') OR starts_with(t.typname,'large_import173_') OR starts_with(t.typname,'_large_import_') OR starts_with(t.typname,'_large_import173_'))),
 'ri',(SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('relation',tr.tgrelid::regclass::text,'constraint_relation',con.conrelid::regclass::text,'constraint',con.conname,'definition',pg_get_constraintdef(con.oid,true),'type',tr.tgtype,'enabled',tr.tgenabled,'function',tr.tgfoid::regprocedure::text,'deferrable',tr.tgdeferrable,'deferred',tr.tginitdeferred) ORDER BY tr.tgrelid::regclass::text,con.conrelid::regclass::text,con.conname,tr.tgtype,tr.tgfoid::regprocedure::text),'[]'::jsonb) FROM pg_trigger tr JOIN pg_constraint con ON con.oid=tr.tgconstraint WHERE tr.tgisinternal AND (con.conrelid IN(SELECT oid FROM own) OR con.confrelid IN(SELECT oid FROM own))),
 'roles',(SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(r)-'oid'-'rolpassword' ORDER BY rolname),'[]'::jsonb) FROM pg_roles r WHERE oid IN(SELECT role_oid FROM reachable)),
 'memberships',(SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('role',pg_get_userbyid(roleid),'member',pg_get_userbyid(member),'grantor',pg_get_userbyid(grantor),'admin',admin_option,'inherit',inherit_option,'set',set_option) ORDER BY roleid::regrole::text,member::regrole::text,grantor::regrole::text),'[]'::jsonb) FROM pg_auth_members WHERE member IN(SELECT role_oid FROM reachable) OR roleid IN(SELECT role_oid FROM reachable))
) profile
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.large_import173_require(expected_profile_sha256 text)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public'
 SET "TimeZone" TO 'UTC'
AS $function$
BEGIN
 IF expected_profile_sha256 IS NULL OR expected_profile_sha256 !~ '^[a-f0-9]{64}$'
 OR (SELECT profile_sha256 FROM public.large_import173_certificate WHERE singleton) IS DISTINCT FROM expected_profile_sha256
 OR encode(sha256(convert_to(public.large_import173_metadata()::text,'UTF8')),'hex') IS DISTINCT FROM expected_profile_sha256
 OR public.large_import173_valid() IS DISTINCT FROM true THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'Large import173 certificate failed' USING ERRCODE='23514';
 END IF;
END
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.large_import_core_scope173_index(s text)
 RETURNS bigint
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 IMMUTABLE STRICT
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$
BEGIN
 -- JS array-index property: canonical decimal0..2^32-2.2^32-1 and zero-padded names are ordinary strings.
 IF length(s)=0 OR length(s)>10 OR s~'[^0-9]' OR length(s)>1 AND left(s,1)='0' THEN RETURN NULL;END IF;
 IF s::numeric<=4294967294 THEN RETURN s::bigint;END IF;
 RETURN NULL;
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.large_import_core_scope173_quote(s text)
 RETURNS text
 LANGUAGE sql
 IMMUTABLE STRICT
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$
 SELECT chr(34)||coalesce(string_agg(CASE
  WHEN cp=34 OR cp=92 THEN chr(92)||ch
  WHEN cp=8 THEN chr(92)||'b' WHEN cp=9 THEN chr(92)||'t' WHEN cp=10 THEN chr(92)||'n'
  WHEN cp=12 THEN chr(92)||'f' WHEN cp=13 THEN chr(92)||'r'
  WHEN cp<32 THEN chr(92)||'u'||lpad(to_hex(cp),4,'0')
  ELSE ch END,'' ORDER BY i),'')||chr(34)
 FROM (SELECT i,substr(s,i,1) ch,ascii(substr(s,i,1)) cp FROM generate_series(1,char_length(s)) i) x
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.large_import_quota_lock_cleanup_pin173(u uuid, t uuid, k uuid, q uuid, token text, key0 text, n bigint, sha text)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public'
 SET "TimeZone" TO 'UTC'
AS $function$
DECLARE b record;x record;
BEGIN
 -- No actor grant or extra capacity: only owner-approved schema generation changes cadence.
 PERFORM public.ordinary182_require_generation();
 IF current_setting('role',true) IS DISTINCT FROM 'dyna_app' OR current_setting('app.tenant_id',true) IS DISTINCT FROM t::text
 OR session_user IS DISTINCT FROM pg_get_userbyid((SELECT relowner FROM pg_class WHERE oid='public.large_import173_certificate'::regclass)) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Cleanup requires certified owned app transport' USING ERRCODE='42501';END IF;
 -- No global/tenant quota locks: caller already committed intents; no new capacity or receipt allocation occurs here.
 SELECT * INTO b FROM public.large_import_quota_reservations173 WHERE tenant_id=t AND id=q AND actor_id=u AND api_key_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM k AND token_hash=token FOR SHARE;
 IF NOT FOUND OR b.kind IS DISTINCT FROM 'upload' OR b.state='retained' THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Cleanup reservation not active/owned' USING ERRCODE='42501';END IF;
 SELECT * INTO x FROM public.large_import_quota_resources173 WHERE tenant_id=t AND reservation_id=q AND resource_key=key0 FOR SHARE;
 IF NOT FOUND OR x.kind IS DISTINCT FROM 'blob' OR x.state='released' OR x.byte_count IS DISTINCT FROM n OR x.sha256 IS DISTINCT FROM sha
 OR key0 !~ '^blob:fs:(blobs|uploads|witnesses):[a-f0-9-]{36}:lock:[a-f0-9-]{36}$'
 OR (x.payload_text::jsonb->>'schema') IS DISTINCT FROM 'private-import-lock/v1'
 OR (x.payload_text::jsonb->>'id') IS DISTINCT FROM split_part(key0,':',6)
 OR (SELECT count(*) FROM jsonb_object_keys(x.payload_text::jsonb))<>2 THEN
 RAISE EXCEPTION 'Cleanup only permits original exact transient lock' USING ERRCODE='42501';END IF;
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.large_import173_certificate_seal()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public'
 SET "TimeZone" TO 'UTC'
AS $function$
BEGIN
 IF TG_OP<>'INSERT' OR current_user<>session_user OR NOT NEW.singleton
 OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.large_import173_certificate)
 OR NEW.profile IS DISTINCT FROM public.large_import173_metadata()
 OR NEW.predecessor_map IS DISTINCT FROM public.large_import173_predecessor_map()
 OR public.large_import173_parents_valid() IS DISTINCT FROM true THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'Large import173 certificate is immutable' USING ERRCODE='23514';
 END IF;RETURN NEW;
END
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.large_import173_immutable(j jsonb)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE sql
 IMMUTABLE
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$
 SELECT jsonb_build_object('schema',j->'schema','id',j->'id','principal',j->'principal','raw',j->'raw','manifest',j->'manifest','parsing_spec',j->'parsing_spec','plan_hash',j->'plan_hash',
 'core',(SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('previewKey',c->'previewKey','executeKey',c->'executeKey','request',c->'request','identities',c->'identities') ORDER BY n) FROM jsonb_array_elements(j->'core') WITH ORDINALITY AS a(c,n)))
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.large_import173_metadata()
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public'
 SET "TimeZone" TO 'UTC'
AS $function$
-- Fixed owner SELECT, also used verbatim by startup; it invokes no candidate helper.
-- Portable semantic identifiers; generated FK trigger allocation names/OIDs are deliberately excluded.
WITH RECURSIVE own AS (SELECT c.* FROM pg_class c WHERE c.relnamespace='public'::regnamespace
 AND (starts_with(c.relname,'large_import_') OR starts_with(c.relname,'large_import173_'))),
 own_functions AS (SELECT p.* FROM pg_proc p WHERE p.pronamespace='public'::regnamespace
 AND (starts_with(p.proname,'large_import_') OR starts_with(p.proname,'large_import173_'))),
 reachable(role_oid) AS (SELECT oid FROM pg_roles WHERE rolname='dyna_app' UNION SELECT relowner FROM own UNION SELECT nspowner FROM pg_namespace WHERE oid='public'::regnamespace UNION SELECT m.roleid FROM pg_auth_members m JOIN reachable r ON r.role_oid=m.member)
SELECT jsonb_build_object(
 'namespace',(SELECT jsonb_build_object('name',nspname,'owner',pg_get_userbyid(nspowner),'acl_is_null',nspacl IS NULL,'acl',public.pim_dictionary_acl_metadata(coalesce(nspacl,acldefault('n'::"char",nspowner)))) FROM pg_namespace WHERE oid='public'::regnamespace),
 'default_acl',(SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('owner',pg_get_userbyid(defaclrole),'schema',CASE WHEN defaclnamespace=0 THEN NULL ELSE defaclnamespace::regnamespace::text END,'kind',defaclobjtype,'acl',public.pim_dictionary_acl_metadata(defaclacl)) ORDER BY pg_get_userbyid(defaclrole)::text,defaclnamespace::regnamespace::text,defaclobjtype),'[]'::jsonb) FROM pg_default_acl WHERE defaclrole IN(SELECT role_oid FROM reachable) AND defaclnamespace IN(0,'public'::regnamespace::oid)),
 'reserved',(SELECT jsonb_build_object('constraints',(SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('name',conname,'relation',conrelid::regclass::text) ORDER BY conrelid::regclass::text,conname),'[]'::jsonb) FROM pg_constraint WHERE connamespace='public'::regnamespace AND (starts_with(conname,'large_import_') OR starts_with(conname,'large_import173_'))),'triggers',(SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('name',tgname,'relation',tgrelid::regclass::text) ORDER BY tgrelid::regclass::text,tgname),'[]'::jsonb) FROM pg_trigger WHERE NOT tgisinternal AND (starts_with(tgname,'large_import_') OR starts_with(tgname,'large_import173_'))),'policies',(SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('name',polname,'relation',polrelid::regclass::text) ORDER BY polrelid::regclass::text,polname),'[]'::jsonb) FROM pg_policy WHERE starts_with(polname,'large_import_') OR starts_with(polname,'large_import173_')))),
 'classes',(SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('name',relname,'kind',relkind,'owner',pg_get_userbyid(relowner),'persistence',relpersistence,'acl',public.pim_dictionary_acl_metadata(coalesce(relacl,acldefault('r'::"char",relowner)))) ORDER BY relname),'[]'::jsonb) FROM own),
 'relations',(SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('name',c.relname,'kind',c.relkind,'owner',pg_get_userbyid(c.relowner),'persistence',c.relpersistence,'rls',c.relrowsecurity,'force_rls',c.relforcerowsecurity,'replica_identity',c.relreplident,'options',c.reloptions,'access_method',am.amname,
 'acl',public.pim_dictionary_acl_metadata(coalesce(c.relacl,acldefault('r'::"char",c.relowner))),
 'columns',(SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('position',a.attnum,'dropped',a.attisdropped,'dimensions',a.attndims,'length',a.attlen,'by_value',a.attbyval,'alignment',a.attalign,'has_missing',a.atthasmissing,'missing_value',to_jsonb(a.attmissingval),'name',a.attname,'type',format_type(a.atttypid,a.atttypmod),'not_null',a.attnotnull,'identity',a.attidentity,'generated',a.attgenerated,'storage',a.attstorage,'compression',a.attcompression,'statistics',a.attstattarget,'options',a.attoptions,'collation',CASE WHEN a.attcollation=0 THEN NULL ELSE a.attcollation::regcollation::text END,'default',pg_get_expr(d.adbin,d.adrelid),'acl',public.pim_dictionary_acl_metadata(a.attacl)) ORDER BY a.attnum),'[]'::jsonb) FROM pg_attribute a LEFT JOIN pg_attrdef d ON(d.adrelid,d.adnum)=(a.attrelid,a.attnum) WHERE a.attrelid=c.oid AND a.attnum>0),
 'constraints',(SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('name',conname,'kind',contype,'validated',convalidated,'enforced',conenforced,'period',conperiod,'local',conislocal,'inheritance_count',coninhcount,'no_inherit',connoinherit,'parent',CASE WHEN conparentid=0 THEN NULL ELSE (SELECT jsonb_build_object('name',par.conname,'relation',par.conrelid::regclass::text) FROM pg_constraint par WHERE par.oid=con.conparentid) END,'deferrable',condeferrable,'deferred',condeferred,'definition',pg_get_constraintdef(oid,true),'columns',(SELECT jsonb_agg(a.attname ORDER BY n) FROM unnest(conkey) WITH ORDINALITY k(attnum,n) JOIN pg_attribute a ON(a.attrelid,a.attnum)=(conrelid,k.attnum)),'foreign_relation',CASE WHEN confrelid=0 THEN NULL ELSE confrelid::regclass::text END,'foreign_columns',(SELECT jsonb_agg(a.attname ORDER BY n) FROM unnest(confkey) WITH ORDINALITY k(attnum,n) JOIN pg_attribute a ON(a.attrelid,a.attnum)=(confrelid,k.attnum)),'update',confupdtype,'delete',confdeltype,'match',confmatchtype) ORDER BY conname),'[]'::jsonb) FROM pg_constraint con WHERE con.conrelid=c.oid),
 'indexes',(SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('name',idx.relname,'definition',pg_get_indexdef(i.indexrelid),'valid',i.indisvalid,'ready',i.indisready,'live',i.indislive,'unique',i.indisunique,'primary',i.indisprimary,'clustered',i.indisclustered,'replica_identity',i.indisreplident,'options',idx.reloptions,'owner',pg_get_userbyid(idx.relowner),'access_method',iam.amname) ORDER BY idx.relname),'[]'::jsonb) FROM pg_index i JOIN pg_class idx ON idx.oid=i.indexrelid LEFT JOIN pg_am iam ON iam.oid=idx.relam WHERE i.indrelid=c.oid),
 'policies',(SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('name',polname,'command',polcmd,'permissive',polpermissive,'roles',(SELECT jsonb_agg(CASE WHEN id=0 THEN 'PUBLIC' ELSE pg_get_userbyid(id) END ORDER BY CASE WHEN id=0 THEN 'PUBLIC' ELSE pg_get_userbyid(id)::text END) FROM unnest(polroles) r(id)),'using',pg_get_expr(polqual,polrelid),'check',pg_get_expr(polwithcheck,polrelid)) ORDER BY polname),'[]'::jsonb) FROM pg_policy WHERE polrelid=c.oid),
 'triggers',(SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('name',tgname,'type',tgtype,'enabled',tgenabled,'definition',pg_get_triggerdef(oid,true),'function',tgfoid::regprocedure::text,'arguments_hex',encode(tgargs,'hex'),'deferrable',tgdeferrable,'deferred',tginitdeferred,'parent',CASE WHEN tgparentid=0 THEN NULL ELSE (SELECT tgname FROM pg_trigger p WHERE p.oid=t.tgparentid) END) ORDER BY tgname),'[]'::jsonb) FROM pg_trigger t WHERE tgrelid=c.oid AND NOT tgisinternal)) ORDER BY c.relname),'[]'::jsonb) FROM own c LEFT JOIN pg_am am ON am.oid=c.relam WHERE c.relkind IN('r','p','v','m','S','f')),
 'functions',(SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(public.pim_dictionary_function_metadata(oid)||jsonb_build_object('body_sha256',encode(sha256(convert_to(prosrc,'UTF8')),'hex')) ORDER BY oid::regprocedure::text),'[]'::jsonb) FROM own_functions),
 'types',(SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('name',t.typname,'kind',t.typtype,'category',t.typcategory,'owner',pg_get_userbyid(t.typowner),'relation',CASE WHEN t.typrelid=0 THEN NULL ELSE t.typrelid::regclass::text END,'element',CASE WHEN t.typelem=0 THEN NULL ELSE format_type(t.typelem,NULL) END,'not_null',t.typnotnull,'default',t.typdefault,'acl',public.pim_dictionary_acl_metadata(coalesce(t.typacl,acldefault('T'::"char",t.typowner)))) ORDER BY t.typname),'[]'::jsonb) FROM pg_type t WHERE t.typnamespace='public'::regnamespace AND (starts_with(t.typname,'large_import_') OR starts_with(t.typname,'large_import173_') OR starts_with(t.typname,'_large_import_') OR starts_with(t.typname,'_large_import173_'))),

BEGIN

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.large_import173_require(expected_profile_sha256 text)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public'
 SET "TimeZone" TO 'UTC'
AS $function$
BEGIN
 IF expected_profile_sha256 IS NULL OR expected_profile_sha256 !~ '^[a-f0-9]{64}$'
 OR (SELECT profile_sha256 FROM public.large_import173_certificate WHERE singleton) IS DISTINCT FROM expected_profile_sha256
 OR encode(sha256(convert_to(public.large_import173_metadata()::text,'UTF8')),'hex') IS DISTINCT FROM expected_profile_sha256
 OR public.large_import173_valid() IS DISTINCT FROM true THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'Large import173 certificate failed' USING ERRCODE='23514';
 END IF;
END
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.large_import173_validate_recovered(expected_profile_sha256 text)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public'
 SET "TimeZone" TO 'UTC'
AS $function$
BEGIN
 -- Detached restoration compares portable descriptors, roles and bodies; never claims restored OID equality.
 PERFORM public.large_import173_require(expected_profile_sha256);RETURN true;
EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN RETURN false;
END

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.large_import_core_scope173_index(s text)
 RETURNS bigint
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 IMMUTABLE STRICT
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$
BEGIN
 -- JS array-index property: canonical decimal0..2^32-2.2^32-1 and zero-padded names are ordinary strings.
 IF length(s)=0 OR length(s)>10 OR s~'[^0-9]' OR length(s)>1 AND left(s,1)='0' THEN RETURN NULL;END IF;
 IF s::numeric<=4294967294 THEN RETURN s::bigint;END IF;
 RETURN NULL;
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.large_import_core_scope173_quote(s text)
 RETURNS text
 LANGUAGE sql
 IMMUTABLE STRICT
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$
 SELECT chr(34)||coalesce(string_agg(CASE
  WHEN cp=34 OR cp=92 THEN chr(92)||ch
  WHEN cp=8 THEN chr(92)||'b' WHEN cp=9 THEN chr(92)||'t' WHEN cp=10 THEN chr(92)||'n'
  WHEN cp=12 THEN chr(92)||'f' WHEN cp=13 THEN chr(92)||'r'
  WHEN cp<32 THEN chr(92)||'u'||lpad(to_hex(cp),4,'0')
  ELSE ch END,'' ORDER BY i),'')||chr(34)
 FROM (SELECT i,substr(s,i,1) ch,ascii(substr(s,i,1)) cp FROM generate_series(1,char_length(s)) i) x
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.large_import_quota_lock_cleanup_pin173(u uuid, t uuid, k uuid, q uuid, token text, key0 text, n bigint, sha text)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public'
 SET "TimeZone" TO 'UTC'
AS $function$
DECLARE b record;x record;
BEGIN
 IF current_setting('role',true) IS DISTINCT FROM 'dyna_app' OR current_setting('app.tenant_id',true) IS DISTINCT FROM t::text
 OR session_user IS DISTINCT FROM pg_get_userbyid((SELECT relowner FROM pg_class WHERE oid='public.large_import173_certificate'::regclass))
 OR public.large_import173_valid() IS DISTINCT FROM true THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Cleanup requires certified owned app transport' USING ERRCODE='42501';END IF;
 -- No global/tenant quota locks: caller already committed intents; no new capacity or receipt allocation occurs here.
 SELECT * INTO b FROM public.large_import_quota_reservations173 WHERE tenant_id=t AND id=q AND actor_id=u AND api_key_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM k AND token_hash=token FOR SHARE;
 IF NOT FOUND OR b.kind IS DISTINCT FROM 'upload' OR b.state='retained' THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Cleanup reservation not active/owned' USING ERRCODE='42501';END IF;
 SELECT * INTO x FROM public.large_import_quota_resources173 WHERE tenant_id=t AND reservation_id=q AND resource_key=key0 FOR SHARE;
 IF NOT FOUND OR x.kind IS DISTINCT FROM 'blob' OR x.state='released' OR x.byte_count IS DISTINCT FROM n OR x.sha256 IS DISTINCT FROM sha
 OR key0 !~ '^blob:fs:(blobs|uploads|witnesses):[a-f0-9-]{36}:lock:[a-f0-9-]{36}$'
 OR (x.payload_text::jsonb->>'schema') IS DISTINCT FROM 'private-import-lock/v1'
 OR (x.payload_text::jsonb->>'id') IS DISTINCT FROM split_part(key0,':',6)
 OR (SELECT count(*) FROM jsonb_object_keys(x.payload_text::jsonb))<>2 THEN
 RAISE EXCEPTION 'Cleanup only permits original exact transient lock' USING ERRCODE='42501';END IF;
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.print_job_guards()
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
 SELECT current_setting('session_replication_role')='origin'
 AND (SELECT count(*) FROM pg_class WHERE oid=ANY(ARRAY['print_printers'::regclass,'print_jobs'::regclass,'print_job_events'::regclass]) AND relrowsecurity AND relforcerowsecurity)=3
 AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM (VALUES ('print_printers','print_job_printer_guard','print_job_guard()',false),('print_jobs','print_job_job_guard','print_job_guard()',false),('print_job_events','print_job_event_immutable','print_job_immutable()',false),('print_job_events','print_job_event_complete','print_job_complete()',true)) g(rel,n,fn,d)
 WHERE NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM pg_trigger t WHERE t.tgrelid=to_regclass(g.rel) AND t.tgname::text=g.n AND t.tgfoid=to_regprocedure(g.fn) AND t.tgenabled='O' AND NOT t.tgisinternal AND t.tgdeferrable=g.d AND t.tginitdeferred=g.d))
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.label_print_guards()
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
 SELECT current_setting('session_replication_role')='origin'
 AND (SELECT count(*) FROM pg_class WHERE oid=ANY(ARRAY(SELECT to_regclass(x) FROM unnest(ARRAY['print_label_assets','print_label_previews','print_job_label_sources']) x)) AND relrowsecurity AND relforcerowsecurity)=3
 AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM unnest(ARRAY['label_print_installed()','label_print_require(uuid,uuid,boolean)','label_print_frame(uuid,uuid,uuid)','label_print_configuration(jsonb,jsonb)','label_print_preview_replay(uuid,jsonb,uuid,uuid)','label_print_store_preview(jsonb,uuid,uuid)','label_print_asset(uuid,uuid,uuid)','label_print_queue_replay(uuid,jsonb,uuid,uuid)','label_print_queue(uuid,jsonb,text,uuid,uuid)','label_print_budget()','label_print_immutable()','label_print_budget_trigger()','label_print_guard()','label_print_seal()']) x WHERE to_regprocedure(x) IS NULL)
 AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM unnest(ARRAY['print_label_assets','print_label_previews','print_job_label_sources']) x WHERE has_table_privilege('dyna_app',to_regclass(x),'INSERT,UPDATE,DELETE'))
 AND NOT has_column_privilege('dyna_app',to_regclass('print_label_assets'),'content_encrypted','SELECT')
 AND NOT has_column_privilege('dyna_app',to_regclass('print_label_assets'),'source_frame','SELECT')
 AND (SELECT count(*) FROM pg_constraint WHERE conrelid=to_regclass('print_label_assets') AND contype='f' AND convalidated AND cardinality(conkey)=2)=3
 AND (SELECT count(*) FROM pg_constraint WHERE conrelid=to_regclass('print_label_previews') AND contype='f' AND convalidated AND cardinality(conkey)=2)=6
 AND (SELECT count(*) FROM pg_constraint WHERE conrelid=to_regclass('print_job_label_sources') AND contype='f' AND convalidated AND cardinality(conkey)=2)=6
 AND (SELECT count(*) FROM pg_constraint WHERE conrelid=to_regclass('print_job_label_sources') AND contype='f' AND convalidated AND condeferrable AND condeferred)=1
 AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM pg_constraint WHERE conrelid='print_jobs'::regclass AND conname='print_jobs_source_kind_check' AND convalidated AND position('shipment_label' IN pg_get_constraintdef(oid))>0)
 AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM pg_constraint WHERE conrelid='shipping_plans'::regclass AND conname='shipping_plans_tenant_id_unique' AND contype='u' AND convalidated)
 AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM pg_index WHERE indexrelid=to_regclass('print_label_preview_page') AND indisvalid)
 AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM (
  SELECT x rel,'label_print_immutable' n,'label_print_immutable()' fn,false d FROM unnest(ARRAY['print_label_assets','print_label_previews','print_job_label_sources']) x
  UNION ALL SELECT x,'label_print_budget','label_print_budget_trigger()',false FROM unnest(ARRAY['print_printers','print_jobs','print_job_events','print_label_assets','print_label_previews','print_job_label_sources']) x
  UNION ALL SELECT x,'label_print_seal','label_print_seal()',false FROM unnest(ARRAY['orders','shipments','shipping_plans','packing_stations','print_printers']) x
  UNION ALL SELECT 'print_jobs','label_print_job_guard','label_print_guard()',false
  UNION ALL SELECT 'print_job_label_sources','label_print_source_complete','label_print_guard()',true
 ) g WHERE NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM pg_trigger z WHERE z.tgrelid=to_regclass(g.rel) AND z.tgname::text=g.n AND z.tgfoid=to_regprocedure(g.fn) AND z.tgenabled='O' AND NOT z.tgisinternal AND z.tgdeferrable=g.d AND z.tginitdeferred=g.d))
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.local_invoice_guards()

AS $function$DECLARE sig text;BEGIN
 FOREACH sig IN ARRAY ARRAY['public.local_invoice_installed()','public.local_invoice_access(uuid,uuid,boolean,boolean)','public.local_invoice_identity(uuid,uuid,text,boolean,boolean)','public.local_invoice_require(uuid,uuid,boolean,boolean)','public.local_invoice_locks()','public.local_invoice_canonical(jsonb)','public.local_invoice_hash(jsonb)','public.local_invoice_request_hash(text,uuid,jsonb,uuid,uuid)','public.local_invoice_text(jsonb,integer,integer)','public.local_invoice_nip(text)','public.local_invoice_definition(jsonb)','public.local_invoice_budget(uuid)','public.local_invoice_frame(uuid,uuid,integer,jsonb,text)','public.local_invoice_immutable()','public.local_invoice_series_guard()','public.local_invoice_command_guard()','public.local_invoice_create_series(jsonb,uuid,uuid)','public.local_invoice_preview_guard()','public.local_invoice_store_preview(uuid,jsonb,uuid,uuid)','public.local_invoice_admission_guard()','public.local_invoice_document_guard()','public.local_invoice_receipt_guard()','public.local_invoice_counter_guard()','public.local_invoice_issue(uuid,jsonb,uuid,uuid)','public.local_invoice_complete()','public.local_invoice_seal()','public.local_invoice_fingerprint()','public.local_invoice_guards()'] LOOP IF to_regprocedure(sig) IS NULL THEN RETURN false;END IF;END LOOP;

operative_delivery_valid.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.operative_delivery_valid()
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public'
 SET "TimeZone" TO 'UTC'
AS $function$
DECLARE cert operative_delivery_certificate;basis record;o oid;n text;expected jsonb:='{"label_print_frame":"d191d4c1280acb4f6c5dec86c23ce72dfce2a5781ad0b0264ed544372454d0c4","order_parcel_source":"5d1ec193a5a147ca758682a3f15ca86c977797717642b833d657397bc4b80fec","packed_label_print_guards":"899a7420b798208ec7350370eb732b98984de00089ec534d7a73f83e1ffcfe0f"}'::jsonb;BEGIN
 IF current_setting('session_replication_role')<>'origin' OR to_regclass('public.operative_delivery_certificate') IS NULL OR to_regclass('public.operative_delivery_evidence') IS NULL
 OR to_regclass('public.buyer_address_manifest') IS NULL OR to_regclass('public.packed_label_print_manifest') IS NULL
 OR to_regclass('public.migrations') IS NULL
 OR to_regprocedure('public.operative_delivery_fingerprint()') IS NULL OR to_regprocedure('public.operative_delivery_functions()') IS NULL
 OR to_regprocedure('public.packed_label_print_fingerprint()') IS NULL
 OR to_regprocedure('public.buyer_address_fingerprint()') IS NULL OR to_regprocedure('public.buyer_address_predecessors()') IS NULL
 OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT FROM migrations WHERE name='156_packed_label_print') OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT FROM migrations WHERE name='166_buyer_address_sidecar')
 OR (SELECT array_agg(relname::text ORDER BY relname) FROM pg_class WHERE relnamespace='public'::regnamespace AND starts_with(relname,'operative_delivery_') AND relkind IN('r','p')) IS DISTINCT FROM ARRAY['operative_delivery_certificate','operative_delivery_evidence']::text[]
 OR (SELECT count(*) FROM operative_delivery_certificate)<>1 THEN RETURN false;END IF;
 SELECT * INTO cert FROM operative_delivery_certificate;
 IF jsonb_typeof(cert.predecessor_functions) IS DISTINCT FROM 'object' OR jsonb_typeof(cert.successor_functions) IS DISTINCT FROM 'object'
 OR jsonb_typeof(cert.original156_manifest) IS DISTINCT FROM 'object' OR jsonb_typeof(cert.original166_manifest) IS DISTINCT FROM 'object' THEN RETURN false;END IF;
 IF cert.profile IS DISTINCT FROM '156-original-to167-operational-receiver/v1'
 OR cert.original156_manifest IS DISTINCT FROM(SELECT to_jsonb(m) FROM packed_label_print_manifest m)
 OR cert.original166_manifest IS DISTINCT FROM(SELECT to_jsonb(m) FROM buyer_address_manifest m)
 OR cert.original166_manifest->>'fingerprint' IS DISTINCT FROM buyer_address_fingerprint()
 OR cert.original166_manifest->'predecessor_certificates' IS DISTINCT FROM buyer_address_predecessors()
 OR cert.original156_fingerprint IS DISTINCT FROM cert.original156_manifest->>'fingerprint'
 OR cert.successor156_fingerprint IS DISTINCT FROM packed_label_print_fingerprint()
 OR cert.successor_functions IS DISTINCT FROM operative_delivery_functions()
 OR cert.own_fingerprint IS DISTINCT FROM operative_delivery_fingerprint()
 OR (SELECT array_agg(key ORDER BY key) FROM jsonb_object_keys(cert.predecessor_functions) keys(key)) IS DISTINCT FROM ARRAY['label_print_frame','order_parcel_source','packed_label_print_fingerprint','packed_label_print_guards']::text[]
 THEN RETURN false;END IF;
 FOR n IN SELECT jsonb_object_keys(expected) LOOP
 IF encode(sha256(convert_to(cert.predecessor_functions->n->>'body','UTF8')),'hex') IS DISTINCT FROM expected->>n
 OR ((cert.predecessor_functions->n)-'definition'-'body') IS DISTINCT FROM((cert.successor_functions->n)-'definition'-'body')
 THEN RETURN false;END IF;END LOOP;
 IF cert.predecessor_functions->'packed_label_print_fingerprint' IS DISTINCT FROM cert.successor_functions->'packed_label_print_fingerprint' THEN RETURN false;END IF;
 IF EXISTS(SELECT FROM migrations WHERE name='167_operational_delivery_consumers') THEN RETURN true;END IF;
 o:=to_regclass('pg_temp.operative_delivery_install_basis');IF o IS NULL THEN RETURN false;END IF;
 IF (SELECT relowner FROM pg_class WHERE oid=o) IS DISTINCT FROM(SELECT relowner FROM pg_class WHERE oid='public.operative_delivery_certificate'::regclass)
 OR current_user IS DISTINCT FROM session_user OR session_user IS DISTINCT FROM(SELECT pg_get_userbyid(relowner) FROM pg_class WHERE oid=o)
 THEN RETURN false;END IF;
 IF(SELECT count(*) FROM pg_temp.operative_delivery_install_basis)<>1 THEN RETURN false;END IF;
 SELECT * INTO basis FROM pg_temp.operative_delivery_install_basis;
 RETURN(basis.root_xid,basis.start_at,basis.backend_pid,basis.owner_name,basis.original156_manifest,basis.original166_manifest,basis.predecessor_functions)
 IS NOT DISTINCT FROM(pg_current_xact_id()::text,transaction_timestamp(),pg_backend_pid(),session_user::text,cert.original156_manifest,cert.original166_manifest,cert.predecessor_functions);
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.packed_label_print_guards()
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public'

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.catalog_stock_count_guards()
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE ownerid oid:=(SELECT proowner FROM pg_proc WHERE oid='public.catalog_stock_count_guards()'::regprocedure);nm text;
BEGIN
 IF NOT public.catalog_stock_control_installed() OR
 (SELECT count(*) FROM pg_class WHERE relnamespace='public'::regnamespace AND left(relname,20)='catalog_stock_count_' AND relkind='r')<>10 OR
 (SELECT count(*) FROM pg_proc WHERE pronamespace='public'::regnamespace AND left(proname,20)='catalog_stock_count_')<>26 THEN RETURN false;END IF;
 IF EXISTS(SELECT FROM pg_class c WHERE c.relnamespace='public'::regnamespace AND left(c.relname,20)='catalog_stock_count_' AND c.relkind='r' AND
 (c.relowner<>ownerid OR NOT c.relrowsecurity OR NOT c.relforcerowsecurity OR EXISTS(SELECT FROM aclexplode(coalesce(c.relacl,acldefault('r',c.relowner)))a WHERE a.grantee<>ownerid)
 OR EXISTS(SELECT FROM pg_attribute x CROSS JOIN LATERAL aclexplode(x.attacl)a WHERE x.attrelid=c.oid AND a.grantee<>ownerid)
 OR(c.relname='catalog_stock_count_manifest' AND EXISTS(SELECT FROM pg_policy WHERE polrelid=c.oid))
 OR(c.relname<>'catalog_stock_count_manifest' AND(SELECT count(*) FROM pg_policy WHERE polrelid=c.oid)<>1))) OR
 EXISTS(SELECT FROM pg_proc p WHERE p.pronamespace='public'::regnamespace AND left(p.proname,20)='catalog_stock_count_' AND
 (p.proowner<>ownerid OR NOT p.prosecdef OR EXISTS(SELECT FROM aclexplode(coalesce(p.proacl,acldefault('f',p.proowner)))a WHERE a.grantee<>ownerid))) THEN RETURN false;END IF;
 FOREACH nm IN ARRAY ARRAY['access','frame','prepare','child_scope','operation_key','location_scope','journal_proof','native_snapshot','bulk_witnesses','bulk_validate','lot_witnesses','lot_validate','finish','validate','budget','abandon','immutable','admission_guard','record_guard','complete','source_seal','fingerprint','guards','require','statement_guard','terminal_require'] LOOP
 IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT FROM pg_proc WHERE pronamespace='public'::regnamespace AND proname='catalog_stock_count_'||nm) THEN RETURN false;END IF;
 END LOOP;
 IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT FROM pg_constraint k WHERE k.conrelid=to_regclass('public.catalog_stock_control_effects') AND k.confrelid='public.catalog_stock_count_receipts'::regclass AND k.contype='f' AND k.convalidated
 AND(SELECT array_agg(x.attname::text ORDER BY v.ord) FROM unnest(k.conkey) WITH ORDINALITY v(att,ord) JOIN pg_attribute x ON(x.attrelid,x.attnum)=(k.conrelid,v.att))=ARRAY['tenant_id','count_receipt_id']
 AND(SELECT array_agg(x.attname::text ORDER BY v.ord) FROM unnest(k.confkey) WITH ORDINALITY v(att,ord) JOIN pg_attribute x ON(x.attrelid,x.attnum)=(k.confrelid,v.att))=ARRAY['tenant_id','id']) THEN RETURN false;END IF;
 IF to_regprocedure('public.catalog_stock_control_effect_validate(uuid)') IS NULL OR to_regprocedure('public.catalog_stock_control_counter_complete()') IS NULL OR
 position('PERFORM public.catalog_stock_count_validate(eid);' IN(SELECT prosrc FROM pg_proc WHERE oid=to_regprocedure('public.catalog_stock_control_effect_validate(uuid)')))=0 OR
 position('FROM public.catalog_stock_count_documents WHERE(tenant_id,series_id,year)=(NEW.tenant_id,NEW.series_id,NEW.year)' IN(SELECT prosrc FROM pg_proc WHERE oid=to_regprocedure('public.catalog_stock_control_counter_complete()')))=0 THEN RETURN false;END IF;
 IF(SELECT count(*) FROM pg_trigger t JOIN pg_proc p ON p.oid=t.tgfoid WHERE NOT t.tgisinternal AND t.tgenabled IN('O','A') AND p.pronamespace='public'::regnamespace AND left(p.proname,20)='catalog_stock_count_')<>44 THEN RETURN false;END IF;
 FOREACH nm IN ARRAY ARRAY['receipts','documents','rows','bin_maps','stock_maps','layer_maps','native_maps','move_maps'] LOOP
  IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT FROM pg_trigger t WHERE t.tgrelid=to_regclass('public.catalog_stock_count_'||nm)
   AND t.tgname='count_statement_before' AND t.tgtype=6 AND t.tgenabled='O' AND NOT t.tgisinternal
   AND NOT t.tgdeferrable AND NOT t.tginitdeferred AND t.tgqual IS NULL AND t.tgnargs=0
   AND t.tgfoid=to_regprocedure('public.catalog_stock_count_statement_guard()')) OR
  NOT EXISTS(SELECT FROM pg_trigger t WHERE t.tgrelid=to_regclass('public.catalog_stock_count_'||nm)
   AND t.tgname='count_statement_after' AND t.tgtype=4 AND t.tgenabled='O' AND NOT t.tgisinternal
   AND NOT t.tgdeferrable AND NOT t.tginitdeferred AND t.tgqual IS NULL AND t.tgnargs=0
   AND t.tgfoid=to_regprocedure('public.catalog_stock_count_statement_guard()')) THEN RETURN false;END IF;
 END LOOP;
 RETURN coalesce((SELECT fingerprint=public.catalog_stock_count_fingerprint() FROM public.catalog_stock_count_manifest WHERE id),false);
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.catalog_stock_control_guards()

 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public'
AS $function$ DECLARE ownerid oid:=(SELECT proowner FROM pg_proc WHERE oid='public.catalog_stock_control_guards()'::regprocedure);BEGIN

  to_regprocedure('public.catalog_stock_control_owns_xmin(xid)') IS NULL OR

 IF NOT public.catalog_stock_control_installed() OR NOT public.catalog_stock_return_guards() OR NOT public.catalog_stock_count_guards() OR NOT public.product_catalog_guards() OR NOT public.warehouse_inventory_policy_guards() OR(SELECT count(*) FROM pg_class WHERE relnamespace='public'::regnamespace AND relname LIKE 'catalog_stock_control_%' AND relkind='r')<>14 THEN RETURN false;END IF;
 IF EXISTS(SELECT FROM pg_class c WHERE c.relnamespace='public'::regnamespace AND c.relname LIKE 'catalog_stock_control_%' AND c.relkind='r' AND(c.relowner<>ownerid OR NOT c.relrowsecurity OR NOT c.relforcerowsecurity OR EXISTS(SELECT FROM aclexplode(coalesce(c.relacl,acldefault('r',c.relowner)))a WHERE a.grantee<>ownerid) OR EXISTS(SELECT FROM pg_attribute x CROSS JOIN LATERAL aclexplode(x.attacl)a WHERE x.attrelid=c.oid AND a.grantee<>ownerid))) OR EXISTS(SELECT FROM pg_proc p CROSS JOIN LATERAL aclexplode(coalesce(p.proacl,acldefault('f',p.proowner)))a WHERE p.pronamespace='public'::regnamespace AND p.proname LIKE 'catalog_stock_control_%' AND(p.proowner<>ownerid OR a.grantee<>ownerid)) THEN RETURN false;END IF;
 RETURN public.manual_inventory_off_valid();END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.financial_return_upgrade_valid()
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public'
 SET "TimeZone" TO 'UTC'
AS $function$
DECLARE c record;tab text;sig text;BEGIN
 IF current_setting('session_replication_role')<>'origin' THEN RETURN false;END IF;
 FOREACH tab IN ARRAY ARRAY['migrations','local_invoice_manifest','fa3_draft_manifest','b2b_invoice_upgrade','b2b_credit_upgrade','credit_source_upgrade_certificate','financial_return_admissions','financial_return_receipts','financial_return_upgrade_certificate'] LOOP IF to_regclass('public.'||tab) IS NULL THEN RETURN false;END IF;END LOOP;
 FOREACH sig IN ARRAY ARRAY['local_invoice_fingerprint()','fa3_draft_fingerprint()','b2b_invoice_fingerprint()','b2b_credit_fingerprint()','credit_source_upgrade_fingerprint()','credit_source_upgrade_valid()','b2b_credit_basis(uuid,uuid)','b2b_credit_calculate(jsonb)','b2b_credit_previous(uuid)','b2b_credit_preview(jsonb,jsonb,jsonb,uuid,uuid,text)','b2b_credit_issue(uuid,jsonb,jsonb,jsonb,uuid,uuid,text)','b2b_credit_record_guard()','b2b_credit_source_seal()','credit_source_upgrade_valid()','financial_return_identity(uuid,uuid,text,uuid,boolean)','financial_return_original(uuid)','financial_return_physical(uuid)','financial_return_frame(uuid,uuid,text,uuid,jsonb)','financial_return_claim(uuid,uuid,text,uuid,jsonb,jsonb)','financial_return_received(uuid)','financial_return_expected(uuid)','financial_return_projection(jsonb,jsonb,jsonb)','financial_return_finish(uuid,uuid,text,uuid)','financial_return_history(uuid)','financial_return_capture(uuid,uuid,text,uuid,jsonb)','financial_return_replay(uuid,uuid,text,uuid,jsonb)','financial_return_admission_guard()','financial_return_receipt_guard()','financial_return_complete()','financial_return_source_seal()','financial_return_terminal(uuid,uuid,text,uuid[])','financial_return_credit_parent(uuid,uuid,uuid,uuid)','financial_return_upgrade_context()','financial_return_fingerprint()','financial_return_upgrade_valid()','financial_return_upgrade_guard()','financial_return_guards()'] LOOP IF to_regprocedure('public.'||sig) IS NULL THEN RETURN false;END IF;END LOOP;
 IF to_regclass('public.document_order_mode') IS NULL OR to_regclass('public.document_return_mode') IS NULL THEN RETURN false;END IF;
 IF(SELECT count(*) FROM pg_class WHERE relnamespace='public'::regnamespace AND starts_with(relname,'financial_return_'))<>12
 OR EXISTS(SELECT FROM pg_class relation_index WHERE relation_index.relnamespace='public'::regnamespace AND starts_with(relation_index.relname,'financial_return_') AND relation_index.relkind='i' AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT FROM pg_index ix JOIN pg_class rel ON rel.oid=ix.indrelid WHERE ix.indexrelid=relation_index.oid AND rel.relnamespace='public'::regnamespace AND rel.relname IN('financial_return_admissions','financial_return_receipts','financial_return_upgrade_certificate')))
 OR(SELECT count(*) FROM pg_class WHERE relnamespace='public'::regnamespace AND starts_with(relname,'financial_return_') AND relkind IN('r','p'))<>3
 OR EXISTS(SELECT FROM pg_class WHERE relnamespace='public'::regnamespace AND starts_with(relname,'financial_return_') AND relkind IN('r','p') AND NOT(relname=ANY(ARRAY['financial_return_admissions','financial_return_receipts','financial_return_upgrade_certificate'])))
 OR EXISTS(SELECT FROM pg_class WHERE relnamespace='public'::regnamespace AND starts_with(relname,'financial_return_') AND relkind NOT IN('r','p','i'))
 OR(SELECT count(*) FROM pg_proc WHERE pronamespace='public'::regnamespace AND starts_with(proname,'financial_return_'))<>23
 OR(SELECT count(*) FROM pg_trigger tr JOIN pg_proc f ON f.oid=tr.tgfoid WHERE starts_with(tr.tgname,'financial_return_') OR(f.pronamespace='public'::regnamespace AND starts_with(f.proname,'financial_return_')))<>6
 OR EXISTS(SELECT FROM(VALUES('financial_return_admission_guard','financial_return_admissions','financial_return_admission_guard()'),('financial_return_receipt_guard','financial_return_receipts','financial_return_receipt_guard()'),('financial_return_complete','financial_return_receipts','financial_return_complete()'),('financial_return_source_seal','return_cases','financial_return_source_seal()'),('financial_return_source_seal','return_items','financial_return_source_seal()'),('financial_return_upgrade_guard','financial_return_upgrade_certificate','financial_return_upgrade_guard()'))expected(name,relation,signature) WHERE NOT EXISTS(SELECT FROM pg_trigger tr WHERE tr.tgname=expected.name AND tr.tgrelid=to_regclass('public.'||expected.relation) AND tr.tgfoid=to_regprocedure('public.'||expected.signature) AND NOT tr.tgisinternal AND tr.tgenabled='O'))
 THEN RETURN false;END IF;
 IF(SELECT count(*) FROM financial_return_upgrade_certificate)<>1 OR(SELECT count(*) FROM local_invoice_manifest)<>1 OR(SELECT count(*) FROM fa3_draft_manifest)<>1 OR(SELECT count(*) FROM b2b_invoice_upgrade)<>1 OR(SELECT count(*) FROM b2b_credit_upgrade)<>1 OR(SELECT count(*) FROM credit_source_upgrade_certificate)<>1
 OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT FROM migrations WHERE name='161_credit_source') THEN RETURN false;END IF;
 IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT FROM migrations WHERE name='162_financial_return') AND NOT financial_return_upgrade_context() THEN RETURN false;END IF;
 SELECT * INTO c FROM financial_return_upgrade_certificate WHERE id;
 RETURN coalesce(c.profile='161-original-to162-financial-return/v1'
 AND c.original=jsonb_build_object('157',(SELECT to_jsonb(m) FROM local_invoice_manifest m WHERE id),'158',(SELECT to_jsonb(m) FROM fa3_draft_manifest m WHERE id),'159',(SELECT to_jsonb(m) FROM b2b_invoice_upgrade m WHERE id),'160',(SELECT to_jsonb(m) FROM b2b_credit_upgrade m WHERE id),'161',(SELECT to_jsonb(m) FROM credit_source_upgrade_certificate m WHERE id))
 AND c.predecessors=c.original#>'{161,successors}'
 AND c.successors->>'157'=c.predecessors->>'157'
 AND c.successors=jsonb_build_object('157',local_invoice_fingerprint(),'158',fa3_draft_fingerprint(),'159',b2b_invoice_fingerprint(),'160',b2b_credit_fingerprint(),'161',credit_source_upgrade_fingerprint(),'162',financial_return_fingerprint())
 AND jsonb_array_length(c.replaced_functions)=8
 AND c.original014_indexes=c.original#>'{160,original014_indexes}'
 AND c.original014_indexes=(SELECT jsonb_agg(pg_get_indexdef(i.indexrelid) ORDER BY i.indexrelid::regclass::text) FROM pg_index i WHERE i.indexrelid IN('public.document_order_mode'::regclass,'public.document_return_mode'::regclass)),false);
END$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.catalog_stock_legacy_group_guards()
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE ownerid oid:=(SELECT proowner FROM pg_proc WHERE oid='public.catalog_stock_legacy_group_guards()'::regprocedure);
BEGIN
 IF NOT public.catalog_stock_control_installed() OR
  (SELECT count(*) FROM pg_class WHERE relnamespace='public'::regnamespace AND relname LIKE 'catalog_stock_legacy_group_%' AND relkind='r')<>3 OR
  (SELECT count(*) FROM pg_proc WHERE pronamespace='public'::regnamespace AND proname LIKE 'catalog_stock_legacy_group_%')<>16 OR
  (SELECT count(*) FROM pg_trigger t JOIN pg_proc p ON p.oid=t.tgfoid WHERE NOT t.tgisinternal AND p.pronamespace='public'::regnamespace AND p.proname LIKE 'catalog_stock_legacy_group_%')<>9 THEN RETURN false; END IF;
 IF EXISTS(SELECT FROM pg_class c WHERE c.relnamespace='public'::regnamespace AND c.relname LIKE 'catalog_stock_legacy_group_%' AND c.relkind='r' AND
  (c.relowner<>ownerid OR NOT c.relrowsecurity OR NOT c.relforcerowsecurity OR EXISTS(SELECT FROM aclexplode(coalesce(c.relacl,acldefault('r',c.relowner))) a WHERE a.grantee<>ownerid) OR
   EXISTS(SELECT FROM pg_attribute x CROSS JOIN LATERAL aclexplode(x.attacl) a WHERE x.attrelid=c.oid AND a.grantee<>ownerid) OR
   EXISTS(SELECT FROM pg_policy policy WHERE policy.polrelid=c.oid))) OR
  EXISTS(SELECT FROM pg_proc p WHERE p.pronamespace='public'::regnamespace AND p.proname LIKE 'catalog_stock_legacy_group_%' AND
   (p.proowner<>ownerid OR NOT p.prosecdef OR NOT coalesce(p.proconfig @> ARRAY['search_path=pg_catalog, public'],false) OR
    EXISTS(SELECT FROM aclexplode(coalesce(p.proacl,acldefault('f',p.proowner))) a WHERE a.grantee<>ownerid))) THEN RETURN false; END IF;
 -- No core-require recursion: these predicates only inspect the actual delegate
 -- bodies; core/RETURN manifests independently pin their complete implementations.
 IF to_regprocedure('public.catalog_stock_return_validate(uuid)') IS NULL OR
  to_regprocedure('public.catalog_stock_return_source_seal()') IS NULL OR
  to_regprocedure('public.catalog_stock_return_guards()') IS NULL THEN RETURN false; END IF;
 IF position('public.catalog_stock_legacy_group_return_basis(eid,to_jsonb(rc))' IN(SELECT prosrc FROM pg_proc WHERE oid='public.catalog_stock_return_validate(uuid)'::regprocedure))=0 OR
  position('public.catalog_stock_legacy_group_close_allowed(to_jsonb(OLD),to_jsonb(NEW))' IN(SELECT prosrc FROM pg_proc WHERE oid='public.catalog_stock_return_source_seal()'::regprocedure))=0 OR
  position('NOT public.catalog_stock_legacy_group_guards()' IN(SELECT prosrc FROM pg_proc WHERE oid='public.catalog_stock_return_guards()'::regprocedure))=0 THEN RETURN false; END IF;
 RETURN coalesce((SELECT fingerprint=public.catalog_stock_legacy_group_fingerprint() FROM public.catalog_stock_legacy_group_manifest WHERE id),false);
END $function$

 AND (SELECT count(*) FROM pg_class WHERE oid=ANY(ARRAY(SELECT to_regclass(x) FROM unnest(ARRAY['print_label_assets','print_label_previews','print_job_label_sources']) x)) AND relrowsecurity AND relforcerowsecurity)=3
 AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM unnest(ARRAY['label_print_installed()','label_print_require(uuid,uuid,boolean)','label_print_frame(uuid,uuid,uuid)','label_print_configuration(jsonb,jsonb)','label_print_preview_replay(uuid,jsonb,uuid,uuid)','label_print_store_preview(jsonb,uuid,uuid)','label_print_asset(uuid,uuid,uuid)','label_print_queue_replay(uuid,jsonb,uuid,uuid)','label_print_queue(uuid,jsonb,text,uuid,uuid)','label_print_budget()','label_print_immutable()','label_print_budget_trigger()','label_print_guard()','label_print_seal()']) x WHERE to_regprocedure(x) IS NULL)
 AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM unnest(ARRAY['print_label_assets','print_label_previews','print_job_label_sources']) x WHERE has_table_privilege('dyna_app',to_regclass(x),'INSERT,UPDATE,DELETE'))
 AND NOT has_column_privilege('dyna_app',to_regclass('print_label_assets'),'content_encrypted','SELECT')
 AND NOT has_column_privilege('dyna_app',to_regclass('print_label_assets'),'source_frame','SELECT')
 AND (SELECT count(*) FROM pg_constraint WHERE conrelid=to_regclass('print_label_assets') AND contype='f' AND convalidated AND cardinality(conkey)=2)=3
 AND (SELECT count(*) FROM pg_constraint WHERE conrelid=to_regclass('print_label_previews') AND contype='f' AND convalidated AND cardinality(conkey)=2)=6
 AND (SELECT count(*) FROM pg_constraint WHERE conrelid=to_regclass('print_job_label_sources') AND contype='f' AND convalidated AND cardinality(conkey)=2)=6
 AND (SELECT count(*) FROM pg_constraint WHERE conrelid=to_regclass('print_job_label_sources') AND contype='f' AND convalidated AND condeferrable AND condeferred)=1
 AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM pg_constraint WHERE conrelid='print_jobs'::regclass AND conname='print_jobs_source_kind_check' AND convalidated AND position('shipment_label' IN pg_get_constraintdef(oid))>0)
 AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM pg_constraint WHERE conrelid='shipping_plans'::regclass AND conname='shipping_plans_tenant_id_unique' AND contype='u' AND convalidated)
 AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM pg_index WHERE indexrelid=to_regclass('print_label_preview_page') AND indisvalid)
 AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM (
  SELECT x rel,'label_print_immutable' n,'label_print_immutable()' fn,false d FROM unnest(ARRAY['print_label_assets','print_label_previews','print_job_label_sources']) x
  UNION ALL SELECT x,'label_print_budget','label_print_budget_trigger()',false FROM unnest(ARRAY['print_printers','print_jobs','print_job_events','print_label_assets','print_label_previews','print_job_label_sources']) x
  UNION ALL SELECT x,'label_print_seal','label_print_seal()',false FROM unnest(ARRAY['orders','shipments','shipping_plans','packing_stations','print_printers']) x
  UNION ALL SELECT 'print_jobs','label_print_job_guard','label_print_guard()',false
  UNION ALL SELECT 'print_job_label_sources','label_print_source_complete','label_print_guard()',true
 ) g WHERE NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM pg_trigger z WHERE z.tgrelid=to_regclass(g.rel) AND z.tgname::text=g.n AND z.tgfoid=to_regprocedure(g.fn) AND z.tgenabled='O' AND NOT z.tgisinternal AND z.tgdeferrable=g.d AND z.tginitdeferred=g.d))
$function$
