CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.operative_delivery_valid()
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public'
 SET "TimeZone" TO 'UTC'
AS $function$
DECLARE cert operative_delivery_certificate;basis record;o oid;n text;expected jsonb:='{"label_print_frame":"d191d4c1280acb4f6c5dec86c23ce72dfce2a5781ad0b0264ed544372454d0c4","order_parcel_source":"5d1ec193a5a147ca758682a3f15ca86c977797717642b833d657397bc4b80fec","packed_label_print_guards":"899a7420b798208ec7350370eb732b98984de00089ec534d7a73f83e1ffcfe0f"}'::jsonb;BEGIN
 -- Explicit177 successor; never a cached current IAM/data decision.
 IF to_regclass('public.wave_print177_certificate') IS NOT NULL
 OR EXISTS(SELECT FROM pg_proc WHERE pronamespace='public'::regnamespace AND starts_with(proname,'wave_print177_'))
 OR EXISTS(SELECT FROM public.migrations WHERE name='177_picking_wave_print') THEN
  IF to_regprocedure('public.wave_print177_valid()') IS NULL
  OR(SELECT encode(sha256(convert_to(prosrc,'UTF8')),'hex') FROM pg_proc WHERE oid=to_regprocedure('public.wave_print177_valid()')) IS DISTINCT FROM '11ad94279989db6d74415da6981f7c8159abcf6ceb06d4cda25612981d0beeb1'
  OR public.wave_print177_valid() IS DISTINCT FROM true THEN RETURN false;END IF;

  RETURN true;
 END IF;

 IF current_setting('session_replication_role')<>'origin' OR to_regclass('public.operative_delivery_certificate') IS NULL OR to_regclass('public.operative_delivery_evidence') IS NULL
 OR to_regclass('public.buyer_address_manifest') IS NULL OR to_regclass('public.packed_label_print_manifest') IS NULL
 OR to_regclass('public.migrations') IS NULL
 OR to_regprocedure('public.operative_delivery_fingerprint()') IS NULL OR to_regprocedure('public.operative_delivery_functions()') IS NULL
 OR to_regprocedure('public.packed_label_print_fingerprint()') IS NULL
 OR to_regprocedure('public.buyer_address_fingerprint()') IS NULL OR to_regprocedure('public.buyer_address_predecessors()') IS NULL
 OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT FROM migrations WHERE name='156_packed_label_print') OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT FROM migrations WHERE name='166_buyer_address_sidecar')
 OR (SELECT array_agg(relname::text ORDER BY relname) FROM pg_class WHERE relnamespace='public'::regnamespace AND starts_with(relname,'operative_delivery_') AND relkind IN('r','p')) IS DISTINCT FROM ARRAY['operative_delivery_certificate','operative_delivery_evidence']::text[]
 OR (SELECT count(*) FROM operative_delivery_certificate)<>1 THEN RETURN false;END IF;
 SELECT * INTO cert FROM operative_delivery_certificate;
 IF jsonb_typeof(cert.predecessor_functions) IS DISTINCT FROM 'object' OR jsonb_typeof(cert.successor_functions) IS DISTINCT FROM 'object'
 OR jsonb_typeof(cert.original156_manifest) IS DISTINCT FROM 'object' OR jsonb_typeof(cert.original166_manifest) IS DISTINCT FROM 'object' THEN RETURN false;END IF;
 IF cert.profile IS DISTINCT FROM '156-original-to167-operational-receiver/v1'
 OR cert.original156_manifest IS DISTINCT FROM(SELECT to_jsonb(m) FROM packed_label_print_manifest m)
 OR cert.original166_manifest IS DISTINCT FROM(SELECT to_jsonb(m) FROM buyer_address_manifest m)
 OR cert.original166_manifest->>'fingerprint' IS DISTINCT FROM buyer_address_fingerprint()
 OR cert.original166_manifest->'predecessor_certificates' IS DISTINCT FROM buyer_address_predecessors()
 OR cert.original156_fingerprint IS DISTINCT FROM cert.original156_manifest->>'fingerprint'
 OR cert.successor156_fingerprint IS DISTINCT FROM packed_label_print_fingerprint()
 OR cert.successor_functions IS DISTINCT FROM operative_delivery_functions()
 OR cert.own_fingerprint IS DISTINCT FROM operative_delivery_fingerprint()
 OR (SELECT array_agg(key ORDER BY key) FROM jsonb_object_keys(cert.predecessor_functions) keys(key)) IS DISTINCT FROM ARRAY['label_print_frame','order_parcel_source','packed_label_print_fingerprint','packed_label_print_guards']::text[]
 THEN RETURN false;END IF;
 FOR n IN SELECT jsonb_object_keys(expected) LOOP
 IF encode(sha256(convert_to(cert.predecessor_functions->n->>'body','UTF8')),'hex') IS DISTINCT FROM expected->>n
 OR ((cert.predecessor_functions->n)-'definition'-'body') IS DISTINCT FROM((cert.successor_functions->n)-'definition'-'body')
 THEN RETURN false;END IF;END LOOP;
 IF cert.predecessor_functions->'packed_label_print_fingerprint' IS DISTINCT FROM cert.successor_functions->'packed_label_print_fingerprint' THEN RETURN false;END IF;
 IF EXISTS(SELECT FROM migrations WHERE name='167_operational_delivery_consumers') THEN RETURN true;END IF;
 o:=to_regclass('pg_temp.operative_delivery_install_basis');IF o IS NULL THEN RETURN false;END IF;
 IF (SELECT relowner FROM pg_class WHERE oid=o) IS DISTINCT FROM(SELECT relowner FROM pg_class WHERE oid='public.operative_delivery_certificate'::regclass)
 OR current_user IS DISTINCT FROM session_user OR session_user IS DISTINCT FROM(SELECT pg_get_userbyid(relowner) FROM pg_class WHERE oid=o)
 THEN RETURN false;END IF;
 IF(SELECT count(*) FROM pg_temp.operative_delivery_install_basis)<>1 THEN RETURN false;END IF;
 SELECT * INTO basis FROM pg_temp.operative_delivery_install_basis;
 RETURN(basis.root_xid,basis.start_at,basis.backend_pid,basis.owner_name,basis.original156_manifest,basis.original166_manifest,basis.predecessor_functions)
 IS NOT DISTINCT FROM(pg_current_xact_id()::text,transaction_timestamp(),pg_backend_pid(),session_user::text,cert.original156_manifest,cert.original166_manifest,cert.predecessor_functions);
END $function$

'print_job_head', 'print_job_printer_head', 'print_job_lock', 'print_job_budget', 'print_job_content_valid', 'print_job_replay', 'print_job_event', 'print_job_printer_write', 'print_job_create', 'print_job_command', 'print_job_content', 'print_job_immutable', 'print_job_guard', 'print_job_complete', 'print_job_guards', 'label_print_installed', 'label_print_require', 'label_print_frame', 'label_print_configuration', 'label_print_preview_replay', 'label_print_store_preview', 'label_print_asset', 'label_print_queue_replay', 'label_print_budget', 'label_print_immutable', 'label_print_budget_trigger', 'label_print_seal', 'label_print_guards', 'packing_current_role', 'packing_key_grant', 'packing_operator_names', 'packing_fulfillment_snapshot', 'packing_fulfillment_hash', 'packing_row_guard', 'packing_budget_guard', 'packing_receipt_after_guard', 'packing_insert_admission', 'packing_scope_guard', 'packing_update_admission','packed_label_print_fingerprint','packed_label_print_guards']) n WHERE NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM pg_proc p WHERE p.pronamespace='public'::regnamespace AND p.proname=n)) THEN  RETURN label_print_guards() AND print_job_guards() AND operative_delivery_valid();END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.catalog_stock_count_guards()
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE ownerid oid:=(SELECT proowner FROM pg_proc WHERE oid='public.catalog_stock_count_guards()'::regprocedure);nm text;
BEGIN
 IF NOT public.catalog_stock_control_installed() OR
 (SELECT count(*) FROM pg_class WHERE relnamespace='public'::regnamespace AND left(relname,20)='catalog_stock_count_' AND relkind='r')<>10 OR
 (SELECT count(*) FROM pg_proc WHERE pronamespace='public'::regnamespace AND left(proname,20)='catalog_stock_count_')<>26 THEN RETURN false;END IF;
 IF EXISTS(SELECT FROM pg_class c WHERE c.relnamespace='public'::regnamespace AND left(c.relname,20)='catalog_stock_count_' AND c.relkind='r' AND
 (c.relowner<>ownerid OR NOT c.relrowsecurity OR NOT c.relforcerowsecurity OR EXISTS(SELECT FROM aclexplode(coalesce(c.relacl,acldefault('r',c.relowner)))a WHERE a.grantee<>ownerid)
 OR EXISTS(SELECT FROM pg_attribute x CROSS JOIN LATERAL aclexplode(x.attacl)a WHERE x.attrelid=c.oid AND a.grantee<>ownerid)
 OR(c.relname='catalog_stock_count_manifest' AND EXISTS(SELECT FROM pg_policy WHERE polrelid=c.oid))
 OR(c.relname<>'catalog_stock_count_manifest' AND(SELECT count(*) FROM pg_policy WHERE polrelid=c.oid)<>1))) OR
 EXISTS(SELECT FROM pg_proc p WHERE p.pronamespace='public'::regnamespace AND left(p.proname,20)='catalog_stock_count_' AND
 (p.proowner<>ownerid OR NOT p.prosecdef OR EXISTS(SELECT FROM aclexplode(coalesce(p.proacl,acldefault('f',p.proowner)))a WHERE a.grantee<>ownerid))) THEN RETURN false;END IF;
 FOREACH nm IN ARRAY ARRAY['access','frame','prepare','child_scope','operation_key','location_scope','journal_proof','native_snapshot','bulk_witnesses','bulk_validate','lot_witnesses','lot_validate','finish','validate','budget','abandon','immutable','admission_guard','record_guard','complete','source_seal','fingerprint','guards','require','statement_guard','terminal_require'] LOOP
 IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT FROM pg_proc WHERE pronamespace='public'::regnamespace AND proname='catalog_stock_count_'||nm) THEN RETURN false;END IF;
 END LOOP;
 IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT FROM pg_constraint k WHERE k.conrelid=to_regclass('public.catalog_stock_control_effects') AND k.confrelid='public.catalog_stock_count_receipts'::regclass AND k.contype='f' AND k.convalidated
 AND(SELECT array_agg(x.attname::text ORDER BY v.ord) FROM unnest(k.conkey) WITH ORDINALITY v(att,ord) JOIN pg_attribute x ON(x.attrelid,x.attnum)=(k.conrelid,v.att))=ARRAY['tenant_id','count_receipt_id']
 AND(SELECT array_agg(x.attname::text ORDER BY v.ord) FROM unnest(k.confkey) WITH ORDINALITY v(att,ord) JOIN pg_attribute x ON(x.attrelid,x.attnum)=(k.confrelid,v.att))=ARRAY['tenant_id','id']) THEN RETURN false;END IF;
 IF to_regprocedure('public.catalog_stock_control_effect_validate(uuid)') IS NULL OR to_regprocedure('public.catalog_stock_control_counter_complete()') IS NULL OR
 position('PERFORM public.catalog_stock_count_validate(eid);' IN(SELECT prosrc FROM pg_proc WHERE oid=to_regprocedure('public.catalog_stock_control_effect_validate(uuid)')))=0 OR
 position('FROM public.catalog_stock_count_documents WHERE(tenant_id,series_id,year)=(NEW.tenant_id,NEW.series_id,NEW.year)' IN(SELECT prosrc FROM pg_proc WHERE oid=to_regprocedure('public.catalog_stock_control_counter_complete()')))=0 THEN RETURN false;END IF;
 IF(SELECT count(*) FROM pg_trigger t JOIN pg_proc p ON p.oid=t.tgfoid WHERE NOT t.tgisinternal AND t.tgenabled IN('O','A') AND p.pronamespace='public'::regnamespace AND left(p.proname,20)='catalog_stock_count_')<>44 THEN RETURN false;END IF;
 FOREACH nm IN ARRAY ARRAY['receipts','documents','rows','bin_maps','stock_maps','layer_maps','native_maps','move_maps'] LOOP
  IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT FROM pg_trigger t WHERE t.tgrelid=to_regclass('public.catalog_stock_count_'||nm)
   AND t.tgname='count_statement_before' AND t.tgtype=6 AND t.tgenabled='O' AND NOT t.tgisinternal
   AND NOT t.tgdeferrable AND NOT t.tginitdeferred AND t.tgqual IS NULL AND t.tgnargs=0
   AND t.tgfoid=to_regprocedure('public.catalog_stock_count_statement_guard()')) OR
  NOT EXISTS(SELECT FROM pg_trigger t WHERE t.tgrelid=to_regclass('public.catalog_stock_count_'||nm)
   AND t.tgname='count_statement_after' AND t.tgtype=4 AND t.tgenabled='O' AND NOT t.tgisinternal
   AND NOT t.tgdeferrable AND NOT t.tginitdeferred AND t.tgqual IS NULL AND t.tgnargs=0
   AND t.tgfoid=to_regprocedure('public.catalog_stock_count_statement_guard()')) THEN RETURN false;END IF;
 END LOOP;
 RETURN coalesce((SELECT fingerprint=public.catalog_stock_count_fingerprint() FROM public.catalog_stock_count_manifest WHERE id),false);
END $function$

 THEN RETURN false;END IF;

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.catalog_stock_legacy_group_guards()
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE ownerid oid:=(SELECT proowner FROM pg_proc WHERE oid='public.catalog_stock_legacy_group_guards()'::regprocedure);
BEGIN
 IF NOT public.catalog_stock_control_installed() OR
  (SELECT count(*) FROM pg_class WHERE relnamespace='public'::regnamespace AND relname LIKE 'catalog_stock_legacy_group_%' AND relkind='r')<>3 OR
  (SELECT count(*) FROM pg_proc WHERE pronamespace='public'::regnamespace AND proname LIKE 'catalog_stock_legacy_group_%')<>16 OR
  (SELECT count(*) FROM pg_trigger t JOIN pg_proc p ON p.oid=t.tgfoid WHERE NOT t.tgisinternal AND p.pronamespace='public'::regnamespace AND p.proname LIKE 'catalog_stock_legacy_group_%')<>9 THEN RETURN false; END IF;
 IF EXISTS(SELECT FROM pg_class c WHERE c.relnamespace='public'::regnamespace AND c.relname LIKE 'catalog_stock_legacy_group_%' AND c.relkind='r' AND
  (c.relowner<>ownerid OR NOT c.relrowsecurity OR NOT c.relforcerowsecurity OR EXISTS(SELECT FROM aclexplode(coalesce(c.relacl,acldefault('r',c.relowner))) a WHERE a.grantee<>ownerid) OR
   EXISTS(SELECT FROM pg_attribute x CROSS JOIN LATERAL aclexplode(x.attacl) a WHERE x.attrelid=c.oid AND a.grantee<>ownerid) OR
   EXISTS(SELECT FROM pg_policy policy WHERE policy.polrelid=c.oid))) OR
  EXISTS(SELECT FROM pg_proc p WHERE p.pronamespace='public'::regnamespace AND p.proname LIKE 'catalog_stock_legacy_group_%' AND
   (p.proowner<>ownerid OR NOT p.prosecdef OR NOT coalesce(p.proconfig @> ARRAY['search_path=pg_catalog, public'],false) OR
    EXISTS(SELECT FROM aclexplode(coalesce(p.proacl,acldefault('f',p.proowner))) a WHERE a.grantee<>ownerid))) THEN RETURN false; END IF;
 -- No core-require recursion: these predicates only inspect the actual delegate
 -- bodies; core/RETURN manifests independently pin their complete implementations.
 IF to_regprocedure('public.catalog_stock_return_validate(uuid)') IS NULL OR
  to_regprocedure('public.catalog_stock_return_source_seal()') IS NULL OR
  to_regprocedure('public.catalog_stock_return_guards()') IS NULL THEN RETURN false; END IF;
 IF position('public.catalog_stock_legacy_group_return_basis(eid,to_jsonb(rc))' IN(SELECT prosrc FROM pg_proc WHERE oid='public.catalog_stock_return_validate(uuid)'::regprocedure))=0 OR
  position('public.catalog_stock_legacy_group_close_allowed(to_jsonb(OLD),to_jsonb(NEW))' IN(SELECT prosrc FROM pg_proc WHERE oid='public.catalog_stock_return_source_seal()'::regprocedure))=0 OR
  position('NOT public.catalog_stock_legacy_group_guards()' IN(SELECT prosrc FROM pg_proc WHERE oid='public.catalog_stock_return_guards()'::regprocedure))=0 THEN RETURN false; END IF;
 RETURN coalesce((SELECT fingerprint=public.catalog_stock_legacy_group_fingerprint() FROM public.catalog_stock_legacy_group_manifest WHERE id),false);
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.large_import_quota_lock_cleanup_pin173(u uuid, t uuid, k uuid, q uuid, token text, key0 text, n bigint, sha text)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public'
 SET "TimeZone" TO 'UTC'
AS $function$
DECLARE b record;x record;
BEGIN
 -- No actor grant or extra capacity: only owner-approved schema generation changes cadence.
 PERFORM public.ordinary182_require_generation();
 IF current_setting('role',true) IS DISTINCT FROM 'dyna_app' OR current_setting('app.tenant_id',true) IS DISTINCT FROM t::text
 OR session_user IS DISTINCT FROM pg_get_userbyid((SELECT relowner FROM pg_class WHERE oid='public.large_import173_certificate'::regclass)) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Cleanup requires certified owned app transport' USING ERRCODE='42501';END IF;
 -- No global/tenant quota locks: caller already committed intents; no new capacity or receipt allocation occurs here.
 SELECT * INTO b FROM public.large_import_quota_reservations173 WHERE tenant_id=t AND id=q AND actor_id=u AND api_key_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM k AND token_hash=token FOR SHARE;
 IF NOT FOUND OR b.kind IS DISTINCT FROM 'upload' OR b.state='retained' THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Cleanup reservation not active/owned' USING ERRCODE='42501';END IF;
 SELECT * INTO x FROM public.large_import_quota_resources173 WHERE tenant_id=t AND reservation_id=q AND resource_key=key0 FOR SHARE;
 IF NOT FOUND OR x.kind IS DISTINCT FROM 'blob' OR x.state='released' OR x.byte_count IS DISTINCT FROM n OR x.sha256 IS DISTINCT FROM sha
 OR key0 !~ '^blob:fs:(blobs|uploads|witnesses):[a-f0-9-]{36}:lock:[a-f0-9-]{36}$'
 OR (x.payload_text::jsonb->>'schema') IS DISTINCT FROM 'private-import-lock/v1'
 OR (x.payload_text::jsonb->>'id') IS DISTINCT FROM split_part(key0,':',6)
 OR (SELECT count(*) FROM jsonb_object_keys(x.payload_text::jsonb))<>2 THEN
 RAISE EXCEPTION 'Cleanup only permits original exact transient lock' USING ERRCODE='42501';END IF;
END $function$

SELECT
 (SELECT count(*)::integer FROM pg_catalog.pg_namespace WHERE nspname='ordinary187_private') schemas,
 (SELECT count(*)::integer FROM rels) relations,
 (SELECT count(*)::integer FROM funcs) functions,
 (SELECT count(*)::integer FROM funcs WHERE prokind<>'f') non_functions,
 (SELECT count(*)::integer FROM pg_catalog.pg_attribute WHERE attrelid IN(SELECT oid FROM rels) AND attnum>0 AND NOT attisdropped) columns,
 (SELECT count(*)::integer FROM pg_catalog.pg_attribute WHERE attrelid IN(SELECT oid FROM rels) AND attnum>0 AND attisdropped) dropped_columns,
 (SELECT count(*)::integer FROM pg_catalog.pg_constraint WHERE conrelid IN(SELECT oid FROM rels)) constraints,
 (SELECT count(*)::integer FROM pg_catalog.pg_index WHERE indrelid IN(SELECT oid FROM rels)) indexes,
 (SELECT count(*)::integer FROM pg_catalog.pg_policy WHERE polrelid IN(SELECT oid FROM rels)) policies,
 (SELECT count(*)::integer FROM pg_catalog.pg_inherits WHERE inhrelid IN(SELECT oid FROM rels) OR inhparent IN(SELECT oid FROM rels)) inheritance_edges,
 (SELECT count(*)::integer FROM trigs) triggers,
 (SELECT count(*)::integer FROM pg_catalog.pg_attribute a CROSS JOIN LATERAL aclexplode(a.attacl) x WHERE a.attrelid IN(SELECT oid FROM rels) AND a.attnum>0) column_acl_entries,
 (SELECT count(*)::integer FROM funcs p CROSS JOIN LATERAL aclexplode(coalesce(p.proacl,acldefault('f',p.proowner))) x) function_acl_entries,
 (SELECT count(*)::integer FROM rels c CROSS JOIN LATERAL aclexplode(coalesce(c.relacl,acldefault('r',c.relowner))) x) table_acl_entries,
 (SELECT count(*)::integer FROM pg_catalog.pg_namespace n CROSS JOIN LATERAL aclexplode(coalesce(n.nspacl,acldefault('n',n.nspowner))) x WHERE n.nspname='ordinary187_private') schema_acl_entries,
